On Saturday, June 20, 2026, I ate at Pizzeria Da Laura for my birthday.

Let me start off by saying if you don't know about Pizzeria Da Laura, you're sleeping big time on great pizza and Italian good in general.

The owner Laura, trained and worked under renowned Pizza Master Tony Gemignani. If you're from the Bay Area and don't know who Tony is, you've been asleep your entire life! Lol 😆 🤣 😂

I had high expectations for Laura's restaurant since she trained with and under Tony for years. Here's what we ordered. The Arancini which came with a red marina sauce, the Ray J New York Style Pizza 18 inch, the Grandma Style Pazzo Pizza, and the Rigatoni in Vodka cream sauce with sausage added to it. The Arancini was different compared to what I was used to. There were artichokes and a touch of lemon inside of the Arancini. It was very earthy tasting. The texture was spot on and the flavors were unique. The Ray J New York Style Pizza is some of the best pizza I've ever had. Two different types of pepperoni, fresh burrata cheese and drizzled with honey! It was such a unique and great tasting pizza. It's unlike anything I've ever had. I would highly recommend this pizza to everyone. The Pazzo Grandma style pizza was good. If you like combination pizza toppings, you'll definitely enjoy this pizza. This was my first time trying a grandma style pizza. I've tried Detroit and Sicilian style pizzas which are way thicker compared to a grandma style pizza. The grandma style pizza dough and crust was thin and very crunchy. It was served cut into an L/triangle shape. Pretty cool. I honestly was kinda upset because we wanted to try their lasagna but they ran out the night before and it wasn't available on Saturday when we are there around 4 pm. We opted for the Rigatoni pasta with Vodka cream sauce and sausage. It was beyond good! It really hit the spot! It was definitely one of the best pasta dishes I've ever eaten. The Vodka cream sauce wasn't spicy and the sausage was super flavorful. The pasta was cooked perfectly. A great dish overall!

I went with 8 people. Everyone loved the food. The atmosphere and decor/vibe of the restaurant is nice. There's a bar area and plasma screen TV's to watch a game. The restaurant is also connected a market/business right next door that sells slices of pizza from Pizzeria Da Laura, Gelato and cookies along with other Italian infused foods. Pretty cool.

Out waiter Justice was excellent! He was very attentive to details and had a great personality. Great service overall.

I took one star off because the Lasagna wasn't available. But its okay because this gives me a reason to go back and try the Lasagna.

Pizzeria Da Laura is definitely a 5 out of 5 star rating restaurant.

BTW, the owner Laura is very nice and down to earth. This was my first time meeting her. I enjoyed talking to her about Tony, various pizza/Italian infused restaurants throughout the Bay Area and just about food/pizza in general. Laura is a class act and I wish nothing but success for her restaurant and future business adventures.

Thanks again Laura and the staff at Pizzeria Da Laura for great food, great service/hospitality and a great birthday dinner!

Our first time so we ordered a crazy amount of pizza just so we could try three different styles: Sicilian, Detroit and NY. All were delicious with excellent crust and texture. The good news is that the pizza also reheats really well. We will certainly be coming back. 😋

Pizzeria da Laura in Berkeley is a fantastic spot for Italian food right in the heart of downtown, just steps from the university. The location gives it a lively downtown vibe with lots of energy from the surrounding area and nearby students.

The reservation and check-in process was very smooth. The staff were incredibly courteous, welcoming, and helpful throughout the visit. I actually arrived about 30 minutes earlier than my reservation time, and they were kind enough to seat us early, which was a really nice touch.

One thing I really like about this place is that they update their dishes a few times a year, so every visit can feel a little different and exciting. The menu has great variety, especially when it comes to pizza styles as you can choose from New York, Sicilian, Detroit, and Grandma-style pizzas, and the pricing is very straightforward for all the sizes they serve.

The pizza was perfectly cooked and tasted great. They also allow you to customize your pizza by adding or removing ingredients, which makes it very convenient for everyone to choose based on their liking. And they add toppings with open-heart.

The pasta was also excellent. We ordered the Peperoncino pasta, and it tasted amazing. The garlic flavor and breadcrumbs were really the highlight and brought out the authentic character of the spaghetti.

Another big plus is that they have plenty of vegetarian options, making it easy for different dietary preferences. The portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable for what they serve.

Food arrived quickly, and the service from the servers and staff was great throughout the visit. The restaurant also has plenty of space and handles reservations well.

The atmosphere is lively with lots of people around and students from the nearby university, which adds to the downtown Berkeley energy. A little more upbeat music could add even more charm to the place.

Overall, this is a place I would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Berkeley. It’s the kind of restaurant I’d happily come back to again and again.

Me and the lady went here, cause of Bay Area Check Please! You know? Cause that’s what we do. The evening we went it was busy, but we had little wait for our table. The homie Fernando was cool and on top of things. It Did however take a min to get the pies. But it wasn’t a crazy long wait. About the pies we got: I got the Detroit style of what’s called The Ray J which is named after Laura’s brother. I saw her make that on an episode Localish. My lady got a New York style of a “make your own”. Both were fire. The dough on the New York style was nice and slightly chewy. And on the Detroit style, the way the cheese cooked around the edges were tasty than a mug! If you know you know. The ambiance was cool. I mean, it’s a pizza place. Music was on point. Nah’mean?!?! Check it out.

Definitely one of the Top 3 Pizza restaurants I have ever been to. The food was INCREDIBLE! The service was top notch. The historic building was beautifully transformed into the perfect space of luxury. What a great experience, and I cannot wait to return to try some more of her Pizza. My wife bought her book in hopes of miraculously recreating our perfect meal! Thank you! ❤️❤️

google.name: Oori Triangles
google.address: 1247 Solano Ave, Albany, CA 94706, United States

top_reviews.content:
They pack generous portions for all options, and their grilled edamame is fantastic, given for free with plates and 3 triangle orders.

I started ordering from them during their opening week, and I have never been let down. Not once. I have tried every type of meat, plates, small plates, and triangles. Everything is superb.

There is no real seating, a couple of tables outside, but their whole menu is to go.

Unexpectedly ordered 3 triangles here for a late lunch and it didn’t disappoint. I ordered on the kiosk, and there was a little bit of a wait. It is a small space with only 4 seats inside. A lot of other people also in line to order and waiting for their food. I would definitely come back and try other triangles, I got the chicken teriyaki, grilled salmon and short rib. All very yummy. I would have been good with two triangles.

While I was waiting for my food, I couldn't help but overhear the employees' unpleasant way of speaking and the way they shouted at each other, with no regard for the space around them. The food is delicious; it was just the way the employees spoke that made me feel uncomfortable.

Heads up!  This is Americanized Onigiri (Japanese Rice Balls).  You are not getting Japanese style “rice triangles” that you would find in Japan and Hawaii in terms of quality (type of rice and seaweed) and style (fillings).  Initially the price seemed expensive because in Hawaii you can get onigiri for $2-$4, but here they are generous with the fillings and it’s a little bigger in size so the price seems fair.  It was pretty good here, but I prefer the traditional Japanese style.

It’s in a school zone so it can get busy.  I found free street parking easily so that was nice.  You order and pay with card on the device to your left when you enter.  You can follow the directions on the screen to pay cash at the register.  It was a full house, but orders were distributed efficiently and quickly.  If the cashier is busy, the chefs help pass out the food so I thought that was great teamwork.

If you want something fast and filling, head to Oori Rice Triangles!
I had spicy pork,  short ribs, and salmon. It's was very delicious. I  also have had their triangles, which are excellent.

reviews_snippets.content: "I'd highly recommend the chicken teriyaki, spicy pork, and their salmon."

I always come here for comfort food that are consistently delicious. I especially love their salt and pepper tofu and eggplant spicy garlic sauce. The portion is huge. The complimentary hot tea also fits great with the food!
Delicious vegetarian food, super affordable and huge portions. Very welcoming family running the place, they gave us a sample dessert from the kitchen at the end of our meal

Yooo! Forgot how good Ike’s is. Had a pastrami Rueben with that sauce. Chefs kiss! Bread, soft and fresh. Pastrami tasty not overcooked or too juicy. That sauce! Mouth is still tingly. Best sandwich in Emeryville.
Shrinking the amount of turkey in the sandwiches. I did not pay $17 for bread. The sandwich is mostly bread and not near as good as it used to be.

Food was phenomenal. Felt like real homemade food.

Recommendations:
-Crispy tofu, sauce was delicious could just eat it by itself.
-thai sausage, a little spicy but soooo good
-beef soup, just so good.
-pompono fish in the picture, bone licking good. flavor was so fresh.

Service was excellent as well.

If you’re looking for a great homemade thai meal this is the spot.

Tasty food ate within a beautiful ambiance as my wife and I celebrated our 10 yr relationship anniversary. That was our waitress that is pictured below. I had Pad See Ew and I can't remember what my wife had. However, she had an entree that had alot of seafood. We mouth enjoyed our meals.

Oh..we had wings, but I was not a fan.

This place is so amazing! My family suffers from celiac disease and so it's always great to find somewhere that can accommodate our diet. Nearly everything on their menu can be made gluten free and they were very knowledgeable about cross contamination prevention practices. Staff was amazing, food was amazing.  Highly recommend this place!

Was in the North Berkeley area and was looking up places to eat for dinner. It was a Saturday night and some places close fairly early and others have wait lists, on Yelp there was availability so we walked over from where we were at and they were able to seat our party of 2 and we didn’t have to sign up. It was very festive with party/club like music and busy! There was indoor and outdoor seating but it was cold outside and more of a waiting area. There’s street parking in a pretty busy main area.

We started with the Sai Aou- Pork Sausage, Thai Papaya Salad (less spicy than Lao), then ordered Panang Curry with Beef (slow cooked) I saw lots of people review this one. It honestly reminded me of Filipino Kare Kare. And we ordered a side of roti (so good to dip) and Pad See Ew with Chicken. My friend ordered a Thai tea and it was very tea/floral. Everything was really good and delicious! Definitely hit the Thai food craving! Lively, colorful, and bright inside! We were able to easily split the bill and they had a handheld machine to pay.

We came on Saturday evening for dinner. I’ve never been here. We came to do a little food tasting possibly use them for catering for an event. So the moment you get there you join a waitlist to be seated. The restaurant was busy but we didn’t have to wait for too long. We waited maybe 8-10 minutes and we were seated.

The restaurant is not that big but maybe they have an area for big parties? I’m not sure. However, the ambiance is cute, cozy, and inviting. I love the accent wall, it’s picture worthy.

Now, let’s talk about the food. We didn’t just order one or two appetizers we ordered four and I highly recommend them: crispy shrimp roll, spicy chicken wings, crispy tofu over peanut sauce, and Roti bread (which I can eat all day). Everything tasted so fresh and like off the stove.

We also order a few dishes: Nam Khao lettuce wrap, crab fried rice, pumpkin curry with chicken and Pad Thai of course. I don’t know if I was hungry or what but everything was delicious. I never had Nam Khao which is a crispy rice with Chinese sausage and crispy pork. I loved it! It is like an explosion ingredients in my mouth so tasty.

The price: I was surprised we ordered so much food and we spent less than $200. We even had cocktail drinks and dessert. Mango Sticky on point! I don’t know about you but I felt like I was eating some really good food but also sort of healthy. I recommend this place  100 percent.

This restaurant sits in a very busy area, college town, so it can be hectic getting here, but there’s street parking and parking garages.  The wait here wasn’t long at all, and the restaurant itself was clean and the staff helpful. If there are lines or if you would rather order from a screen, they offer that here as well. To go orders are offered here as well.

Grabbed a quick lunch here and the koja was delicious - I got the galbi short rib one. The rice patties were crunchy on the outside and nice and chewy on the inside. A little more veg or pickle would have been nice as it was basically just galbi and rice. But overall really tasty rice burger

The menu looks delicious and the food did not disappoint. I️ ordered KoJa short rib and braised pork short rib with their signature fries. Everything packed a yummy punch of flavors. If you want to try Korean but don’t want to be taken back by the new flavors then come here!

The only thing I️ would recommend is that you ask your fries to come out fresh. The toppings were hot but the fries underneath seemed a bit cold.

Non the less this was a great lunch stop :)

this is secretly the best sushi in the east bay. The fish is always fresh. Jin has a daily specials menu of fish that is unique and hard to find. i’ve been here so many times and have been holding back on a review for fear i will no longer be able to get a table here.

We are so lucky to have this gem in our neighborhood. Jin is an incredible chef, overseeing daily fresh fish flown in from Japan, his omakase is comparable to the Michelin sushi spots in sf. … but for a neighborhood price with neighborhood feel.

Fantastic sushi place! This should easily be a Bib Gourmand place! Amazing Omakase menu, done the Japanese way! The owner/chef Jin is very friendly and really passionate about providing the best sushi and experience! You have to go there!

After more than a year of lock-down, we celebrated social liberation with a fabulous sushi dinner sitting at the sushi bar watching the sushi master preparing "Omakase" (chief's choice) assortment of the most delicious and beautifully presented succulent servings of fresh fish east of Japan, all while savoring glasses of fragrant chilled sake from a 1800 ml bottle of Konteki Tears of Dawn Daiginjo - absolutely heaven on earth! top_reviews.content: First time trying this place and everything was amazing. Me and my husband shared lasagna and linguine with arrabbiata sauce, then finished with the best tiramisu I’ve had and a perfect cappuccino.

Okay listen… if you go to Luna Cocina and don’t get Deena, Zahir, and David taking care of you, I’m telling you right now you are missing OUT 😭👏🏽

Let’s start with my girl Deena, my AMAZING server!!! When I say she set the tone for the entire experience, I mean that. She was so attentive, so warm, and just locked in the whole time. We never had to look around or wait on anything. She was already there. Drinks refreshed, orders handled smoothly, everything flowing exactly how it should. And the way she carries herself? You can tell she takes real pride in what she does. That kind of service is what makes people come back and ask for you by name.

Now Zahir… he was ON IT. Supporting the table, making sure nothing was missed, keeping everything moving seamlessly. The teamwork between him and Deena was flawless. You could feel that they genuinely care about the guest experience!

And David?? Let me tell you, it’s the attention to detail for me. So kind, so quick to help, and so intentional. He brought my soft serve margarita with a huge smile on his face so I have to give him props too. He added to my amazing experience!

Now let’s get into this FOOD and DRINKS because wow 😭🔥

The queso with steak? Rich, flavorful, and done RIGHT. The corn ribs? So good, perfectly seasoned, and something you just keep going back to. And baby… even the chips and salsa deserve their own moment. The salsa tastes homemade like you can tell it was made fresh with care. That alone had me impressed.

And the margaritas??? Yeah they are not playing over here. You can choose from so many flavors like mango, peach, strawberry, coconut and more, and every single one is actually GOOD. Not watered down, not basic… flavorful and balanced.

And of course we had to try the viral soft serve margarita 🙌🏽 I got the strawberry and pineapple and it was EVERYTHING. Fun, refreshing, and honestly just a whole experience on its own.

Overall, the food was amazing, the drinks were hitting, but the SERVICE??? Next level. Deena, Zahir, and David didn’t just do their jobs, they created an experience that makes you want to come back again and again.

I took my time to write this because I want to give them ALL the recognition because they truly deserve it 👏🏽

Great little Italian restaurant with an open kitchen. Everything was fresh and homemade. Caprese salad. Sauteed greens was a big plate of kale perfectly sauteed, with whole garlic cloves. And homemade meatballs. A perfect meal!!

Went to this restaurant with my boyfriend. Ordered a salad with chicken, they charged $8.50 for 3 pieces of chicken that was tasteless. (btw just the salad was $10, so the chicken was almost as expansive as just a single salad. 3 pieces of chicken, nonsense) then we ordered lasagna and linguine with alfredo and chicken. again $8.50 for 3 pieces of chicken which we didn’t know about. lasagna seemed reheated and there was a part that was completely frozen, hard to eat. linguine was completely tasteless, not a single flavor, horrible. Service was whatever, only saw the server twice. Ended up paying more than $70 for horrible flavored meals. Never coming back.

Luca Cucina Italiana is one of those hidden West Berkeley gems that feels like a slice of Italy—at least as far as I can tell, having never been to the motherland myself. I’ve eaten at plenty of places where people swear the food is authentically Italian, and this spot has that same unmistakable flavor. The homemade pasta is the real deal, and their tortellini is absolutely bomb. If you're looking for a vegetarian option, though, be sure to ask in advance.

The lasagna and chicken marsala come up a lot in other reviews, and I get why—classic comfort food, done right. The garlic bread? Personally, not my favorite. They season it a little heavier than I’d like, leaning on the saltier side. But that’s a minor quibble when the rest of the meal delivers.

I’ll admit, I’ve had an off night or two here in th
e past, but lately, they’ve been on a streak. The last three times I’ve been, it’s really been hitting. Add in the cozy, homey vibe and friendly service, and you’ve got a spot that’s worth revisiting. It’s small, so plan ahead, but if you’re craving fresh pasta with a solid Italian pedigree, Luca Cucina Italiana is worth your time.

I recently attended a lunch celebration at Co Nam for my niece’s high school graduation, and it was a wonderful experience from beginning to end.

The food was outstanding. Every dish I tried was beautifully presented, fresh, and full of flavor. The shrimp rolls were light and refreshing, the grilled prawn citrus salad was vibrant and delicious, the garlic noodles were packed with flavor, and the roti with curry dipping sauce was impossible to stop eating. Everything that came to the table was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented.

What impressed me just as much as the food was the service. Our group spent hours at the restaurant enjoying the celebration, taking photos, and catching up with family. Throughout the afternoon, the staff remained warm, attentive, and accommodating. Even as we lingered well after lunch, they never made us feel rushed and continued to provide excellent service.

The atmosphere was perfect for the occasion. The restaurant felt inviting and the attention to detail throughout the space complemented the celebration beautifully.

It's easy to find a restaurant with good food. It's much harder to find one that pairs excellent food with genuine hospitality. Co Nam delivered both. I left impressed not only by the quality of the meal but by how welcome they made our entire group feel.

Thank you to the Co Nam team for helping make such a special day even more memorable.

They were great, but the flavor from the “Filet Cheese “Phorench” Dip, Beef Pho Broth Banh Mi will send you to a familiar place you’ve never been to before. The food was cooked by a seasoned cook from the motherland. They only had one server when we went there for lunch, but things moved relatively well. I really enjoyed the mocktails. The food was all around solid with a lot of flavor and plenty full. They also have an extensive selection of cocktails. Overall, I would give this place a visit and enjoy some really good Vietnamese food.

We went here on a Saturday around 3pm and were able to get seated right away. The inside is small and large selection at the bar. It is nicely decorated and could be a good evening spot to hang and drink. We got the ibiza, which is their sweetest drink, and the saigon french quarters, which was strong. Both were good and I look forward to trying other drinks here. They have quite the menu for drinks- alcoholic, non alcoholic, wine, juice, tiki drinks, etc. As for the food, I really enjoyed the roti and the fried wicked buns. top_reviews.content:
We had a great experience at GangNam Jjajang!

We ordered the jajangmyeon, jjambbong, jjambbong-jajang combo, shrimp fried rice, and sweet and sour pork (small), and everything was satisfying.

The jajangmyeon had a rich and savory black bean sauce that was perfectly balanced, and the noodles were chewy and well-cooked. The jjambbong was full of flavor with a deep, spicy broth and generous seafood, making it very comforting.

The shrimp fried rice was light yet flavorful, with nicely cooked rice and plenty of shrimp. The sweet and sour pork was crispy on the outside and tender inside, with a sauce that wasn’t overly sweet, which we really appreciated.

Overall, the portions were generous, the food came out quickly, and everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. We would definitely come back again!

This is the perfect place to hit up if you’re like me and experience intense, borderline violent jajangmyeon cravings. Sometimes you just need a big, comforting bowl of chewy noodles covered in rich black bean sauce, and this spot absolutely delivers.

Their jajangmyeon is done just right. The sauce is savory, hearty, and satisfying without feeling too heavy, and the noodles have that perfect chewy texture that makes the whole dish so comforting. The portion size is also massive, so you could definitely share one order between two people—although I completely understand wanting one all to yourself.

I also tried their fried chicken, which was decent, but it wasn’t the standout for me. It was fine as a side, but compared to the noodles, it didn’t feel like something I’d go out of my way to order again. Next time, I’d probably skip the chicken and focus on what they’re clearly known for: their noodle dishes.

Overall, this is a great spot when you’re craving classic, satisfying Korean comfort food. I’d definitely come back for the jajangmyeon and would recommend it to anyone looking for a generous, flavorful bowl of noodles.

Gangnam Jajang is the real deal!!! I am used to Korean-Chinese as a Korean who used to eat jajngmyeon (black bean noodles) and tang soo yook as a kid.

I started with the iced tea with mango cubes - refreshing, not too sweet, and the large mango cubes at the top were a nice touch. They even had a frozen bear on the top.

The wool-myeon and the chili oil black bean noodles stood out. The wool myeoj noodles have a silky texture with super generous portions with fresh seafood. The chili oil black bean noodles had a savoy jajang base with a kick of heat. The chili oil adds fragrance and makes the noodles super addictive.

The tang soo yook was crispy but chewy on the inside. Definitely recommend this as an appetizer.

The portions are generous based on the price point and the servers were very attentive too!

If you’re anywhere near Oakland and craving Korean-Chinese, do yourself a favor and check it out.

I’ve been coming to Gangnam Jajang since they first opened in January 2022, and it’s been great to see how much the restaurant has evolved over the years. The food has continued to improve little by little, and I can see why it has become a spot that appeals to both Korean and non-Korean diners.

One of their newer dishes, the Spicy Chili Pork Gan-Ja-Jang, is definitely worth trying if you enjoy a little hot. It can sometimes feel quite rich, but the kick from the peppers cuts through that richness surprisingly well. The combination is savory, spicy, and nicely balanced without losing the deep flavor you want from a good fresh Jajang sauce.

I also really like that they’ve added more size options for their Tang-Soo-Yuk (sweet and sour pork). It makes it much easier to order when dining alone without committing to a huge portion. The one pictured here is a medium, which I’d say is plenty for 2-3 people to share. The coating is crisp without being overly heavy, while the pork stays tender and juicy inside. Paired with the sweet and sour sauce on the side, it has that satisfying contrast in texture that makes good tangsuyuk so addictive :-)

After coming here for years, it’s nice to see a restaurant that keeps refining its food rather than simply staying the same. Definitely a place I’ll continue coming back tho whenever I’m craving Korean-Chinese food !

Wonderful Korean food at low prices, cooked fresh to order in a friendly casual venue. Had the jajang noodles with fried chili sauce, and was immediately impressed by the chewy home made noodles and aromatic sauce. Portion was enormous. The fried pork is fluffy and comes with a unique dipping sauce, bright and acidic, keeps you eating! I highly recommend.

top_reviews.content:
The Benchmark Pizza was very good. Sauce, crust, all of it. Delicious.  We also ordered the chopped salad and spicy carrots and a pasta dish that I can't recall the name of.

Overall the experience was great. If you have more than two people, order a second pizza.

Benchmark continues to be one of my favorite spots when a serious pizza craving hits. Last night, I stopped in specifically hoping to try the eggplant pizza, but unfortunately they were sold out. Since the only other pie I’d previously had there was the brown butter sage — delicious, though I’ve learned lemon on pizza simply isn’t my thing — I decided to go with their classic Benchmark margherita instead. It absolutely delivered.

This is Neo-Neapolitan pizza done right: bright, fresh tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, torn basil, and a beautifully balanced crust with a perfectly thin base, nicely charred underside, and those airy, leopard-spotted edges that make wood-fired pizza so satisfying. Simple, restrained, and incredibly well executed.

It was an unusually warm evening, so I opted to sit outside. My only real complaint is that the tables closest to the street sit noticeably on a slant, making it a bit of a challenge to keep plates and glasses from slowly sliding downhill throughout the meal. A small detail, but worth noting.

That said, the staff were genuinely lovely and welcoming, and the overall experience was exactly what I was hoping for. One final recommendation: do yourself a favor and ask for a side of olive oil for dipping the crusts. It’s the perfect finishing touch.

I’ll absolutely be back the next time the craving strikes.

This place serves the best vegan pizza I’ve ever had—worth a visit for that alone. Highly recommend! I also loved their sparkling red wine; we thoroughly enjoyed it. The lemon pizza and the sage pizza were excellent as well.

A few small suggestions as feedback: it would be great to see some vegetarian pasta options added. All the appetizers leaned on sweetness, which wasn’t quite our preference—having a few truly savory starters would be nice. Some chocolate-based dessert options would also be a welcome addition.

Overall, this is easily one of the best pizza spots around! 🍕

The crust here is hands down the best! perfectly chewy with just the right amount of crisp and char. You can really taste the quality in every bite. Their pasta is also solid, always cooked just right and full of flavor. And no visit is complete without ordering the sundae ice cream! it’s a must-have! Creamy, rich, and the perfect way to end the meal. Highly recommend this place if you’re craving great pizza and a cozy, satisfying meal.

One of best pizza spots in the east bay!  Salami and Calabrian Chili pizza was superb. The meat was out of this world. The Caesar salad was excellent. All ingredients very fresh and well cooked. Flavors well balanced for both dishes. Wish I left room for dessert!

Tried this spot for dinner and the smash burgers were seriously so bomb. Easily the highlight of the meal. Super flavorful, and definitely the kind of burger that makes you want to come back. I’ll absolutely be back for another and already have my eye on the Saigon burger for next time.

The shakes, though, were a letdown. They looked good but were pretty lacking in flavor and too watery. The fries were just okay..Nothing bad, but nothing memorable.

My biggest issue was watching the employee pack the fries into the boats with his bare hands. It felt pretty unsettling and honestly unsanitary, especially handling hot, greasy fries that way. Just throw on some gloves or use tongs.

Overall, the burgers alone are worth coming back for, which is why I’m giving 4 stars. I just hope they tighten up the food handling practices a bit.

Very yummy smash burger, fries, and a chocolate shake. Trekked over here from SF to try out their burger and it’s worth the Bart/walk from rockridge. A lovely corner spot in a fancy neighborhood with outdoor seating. The line for ordering can get very very long so be patient.

reviews_snippets.content: "The location and vibes are perfect…def check this place out!"
"The choice of bun, meat, cheese were all very high quality that you could taste."

top_reviews.content: I hesitate to give this review because I don’t want to start seeing lines out the door. However, I know the neighborhood is very aware of a Udupi Palace. My daughter and son-in-law have been to India a couple of times and this is The place they go to revisit the taste of India😉. You’ll get the opportunity to meet the people who have created and serve this establishment. The service is friendly and attentive. The food is the reason one would travel a long way to indulge.

We had a wonderful experience at Udupi Palace! The food was fresh, authentic, and full of flavor. We especially loved the South Indian dishes—they tasted just like homemade food. The service was quick, and the staff was friendly and attentive throughout our visit. The restaurant was clean, the portions were generous, and the prices were very reasonable. If you’re looking for delicious vegetarian South Indian food, I would definitely recommend Udupi Palace. We’ll be coming back!

Thali was lower than average taste. Dosa was very soft and no crisp. i had better options in the bay compared with authentic Indian food. There was some weird smell which turned off the whole ambiance. The service was good.  Paid Street Parking and Public Parking available nearby.
Next Time = Never

We went again today, the food quality ,taste are the Best I have eaten here.  in the bay area . I am a food lover, and being from south indian locality of Mumbai ,know the authenitic taste. We had their Thali and paper masala Dosa. All the curries were fresh and so tasty. Dosa was excellent too, with potato curry.service is always so good ,smiling face!
Their dosas are delicious and filling, and the staff are always very kind! The ambience of the restaurant is chill and it is a great spot to have lunch with friends :)

address: 1956 Shattuck Ave., Berkeley, CA 94704, United States

top_reviews.content: Cute small restaurant, it’s really convenient to go to the theater or just to walk around downtown Berkeley. The menu is diverse, and the food is flavorful. I don’t go to vegan places that often, but this was definitely one of the best I’ve tried. Next time I’ll try the ramen! The potatoes were probably my favorite followed by point Rey’s roll. The mocktails were also really nice! All in all recommend.

Cozy vibe. Nigiri is currently my go-to bc I love to enjoy the purity of each vegetable/fruit.
Eggplant is my ultimate fav. Avocado nigiri is good too but this time there was no truffle salt so that’s what makes this Nigiri. Pickled mango is my new fav in addition to eggplant. Enrygii is saucy!

Currently offering happy hour menu (food & drink) between 5-6pm.

Wow! You will love this place!! It’s rare to find vegan sushi and even more rare when it’s so exceptional. The Pacifica was the perfect amount of crunch, texture, flavor, and layers! The Monterey had a smoky undertone. I wish I could have ordered the whole menu!

As a vegetarian, the sushi’s are a must have! Unbelievable that it’s all vegan. I feel like I’m cheating and eating real sushi. Omg 🤤 so good! Servers were friendly and accommodating. This will be a repeat for sure! Only minor caveat is the place is quite small not enough seating during peak hours, so reserve ahead of time.

Excellent vegan sushi place. A bit on the pricey but kind of worth the experience and ambience.

Host was nice and recommended we try a soft and a crunchy sushi so that we get to experience both varieties. We tried a few crowd favorites and liked the eggplant tempura sushi the best overall hands down.

Chill and cosy ambience. Appointment recommended as it gets pretty busy.

Bonus on the menu is a flaming sushi option

reviews_snippets.content: "Good service, great vibes, yummy food"

top_reviews.content: Very good prices for a Berkeley dive bar. Knowledgeable bartenders. Able to mix to order and very pleased with their abilities.  Atmosphere changes from empty to packed depending on game days and other events nearby.

Went to Kip's to watch G.S. WARRIORS game. Ordered Pineapple Fish bowl to share, Western burger and 5 tacos on Tuesday night. The burger came out first, 45 minutes after we ordered it. Having inquired about our drink, she admitted to forgetting to place drink order. 5 minutes later, we finally get our libation. She charges $35 for the drink, when they were on special for $25. Apparently the "special " had ended at 8pm. It was now 830. I explained that we ordered the drink well before 8 and were forced to suffer from dry mouth for way too long. Too bad, so sad. Shortly thereafter, my tacos arrived. Lots of screens, upbeat vibe, good food, and billiards are enough to return. Service and reconciliation difficult to attain.
easily the best bar in berkeley when a lot of people go. great dancing and great drink deals on Tuesdays too

I’m leaving this review as a recent performer at Kips. I DJed a private event here and had a pretty bad experience. Upon arrival, there was nobody around to assist me with any kind of sound check. The one person who seemed to be in charge up and left when there were some difficulties saying “I don’t know” and storming away, leaving me to scramble through their audio equipment and cables (all of which was extremely dirty and sticky) to figure out how to make THEIR sound system work. It was very chaotic. The inside was hot, sweaty with 0 ventilation and 1 fan. The cherry on top was the staff member who came backstage to flirt with a couple of guests I brought with me, making sexual jokes, physical advances, and being completely inappropriate towards all of us. He made us very uncomfortable and we had to ask him multiple times to leave us alone. It shocks me that college aged students attend a place where staff behave like this, I can only pray this was a one time incident.

The same unhelpful staff from earlier proceeded to shut the event down early, harshly cutting all power and corrupting my USB drive by doing so. This was by far one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had as a DJ and I hope to never set foot in a place like this again.

Theo and Bruna are the best bartenders ever.
On that note this bar is fun. Has a photo booth. And on weekends the downstairs dance floor opens. Which is always fun.
They have a great food menu which I've tried most of but my ultimate favorite is the angus hamburger and the chicken strips and the BLT with chips and salsa on the side I'll always come visit cause the bartenders make me feel at home but in a better enviroment. Is a must if u visit Berkeley.
The photo represent Bruna after serving the greatest bloody Mary's I've ever had.

top_reviews.content:
It was my mom’s first time ever trying Nepali food. We decided to stop at this restaurant and give it a try. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted very kindly by a young man and young lady.

Since we were kind of unsure on what to get, we asked for the young lady’s recommendation and she very patiently gave us options. We ordered the lunch special which was a thali that came with daal, rice, naan, salad and entree of choice, my mom opted for the Chicken Tikka Masala and I chose the Tandoori Chicken. Super affordable by the way…

The both dishes were amazing. My mom was mind-blown by the chicken tikka masala, she said she would dream about it for a while because of how good it was. The tandoori chicken was also delicious as well as the daal and naan. 10/10. Also you can never go wrong with a mango lassi.

This is now one of our favorites in the area. I would definitely recommend to anyone who’s wanting to try Nepali/Indian Food for the first time.

incredible experience having nepalese thali here. This place is true to its taste Nd serves high quality food.very clean and hygienic place.Amazing vegetarian and pahadi food selection. I also got bir

An exceptional experience. The tandoori chicken was outstanding — smoky, juicy, and perfectly seasoned, clearly the work of a chef who truly masters his craft.
Still thinking about this meal. Tandoori chicken cooked to perfection, and the softest handmade momos I've had in a while. Chilli momo with extra sauce = must order. Jhol momo was pure comfort. Expert chef, lovely team. Highly recommend.

Cozy dim lit environment with authentic flavor. The cuisine is always on the richer side when it comes to flavor. The authenticity is worthy of elevated attention and the taste deserves to be experienced. My go to is the tandoori chicken, always seasoned to perfection. The lentil soup is my wife’s favorite and even I cannot refuse a bowl. Overall the service and food is top notch. Hospitality and flavors galore.

Really wholesome tasting food. All dishes I ordered were full of flavor and reminded us of the traditional food my family makes at home. The fragrance and taste were both really inviting. Both the vegetarian and meat dishes were delicious.

Pricing is also very good, especially for the flavorful and well made food. If you like your food spicy, ask for it. Default spice local is somewhat mild.

Will definitely visit again when I'm in the area.

reviews_snippets.content: "Delicious food, pleasant dining room and service."

top_reviews.content:
The food here is good, not great, but how many places are? The chicken is tender and flavorful just not near enough for $21 bucks, my son had the shawarma wrap which he liked. As you can see they pretty much fill up the plate with rice to compensate for the lack chicken, and for some reason they're extremely cheap with pita bread. The cucumber tomato salad was odd to say the least, drowned in what my guess would be a type of tzakiki sauce. The service was good as was the server, would I go back, ehhh' that's up for debate. There's lots of Med places in East Bay.
The Superb-intendent 🍀

Pretty good beef and lamb skewers with rice and their white sauce, on top of the appetizer we ordered with hummus. One comment though on the food (not sure if it’s the beef or the lamb skewer), is that i don’t think the skewer was as fresh as it could have been, hoping that this is just a one off. Overall, the servers were nice and the they have a nice relaxing atmosphere.

The hummus is really good. My salmon was super dry and didn't have much flavor.  The spanakopita didn't have that "spanakopita" flavor like most. My husband didn't care for his food at all. The place is cute and the staff is nice.

Some vegan options. Had the impossible platter in the past and it was enjoyable.
This trip, liked the lentil soup to start. Then Greek salad with no feta and side of 4 falafel. Falafel were decent size and not small pebbles. Crispy on outside and soft inside without being mushy. Added nice hefty to the salad.
Usually there because of non vegan companion eater, so limited choices.
Friendly service and effective though not very busy at early dinner hour.

Finally ate here and the food is really quite good.  Mezze platter was delicious and I was able to get gluten free pita!  They also have a lot of vegetarian options, many featuring impossible meat.  So I had the Impossible wrap and it’s really well spiced, very tasty and huge!  Leftovers!  The only disappointment was the spanakopita which was very bland and didn’t seem to have any feta in it. My mom was very disappointed. They offered to remake it which was very nice. We’ll be back!

top_reviews.content: This isn't my first or second time here, but it will absolutely be my last. The customer service is practically nonexistent—no one greets you, no one says thank you, and the owner is perpetually in a terrible mood. The curly-haired cashier seems to be left to run the entire place by herself. Unfortunately, the coffee suffers; the milk for the lattes is poorly textured and lacks proper microfoam. As for the food, it’s completely underwhelming. For a place with an Italian owner, it certainly doesn't taste like authentic Italian cuisine. Between the inconvenient location, the abysmal service, and the mediocre food, I won't be returning. I strongly do not recommend this place.

This cafe is the epitome of excellence. I’ve been wanting to try it for some time now. The staff was extremely accommodating, knowledgeable, and super friendly.I ordered a prosciutto di Parma panini and a bunch of pastries. They did not disappoint- the panini was perfectly toasted the bread: crispy and buttery, the pesto- to die for, the prosciutto and mozzarella- so fresh. The handmade pastries are beautifully presented and so well made. I highly recommend this spot!

I love this place since being introduced to it by a friend years ago. The croissants taste like those in Europe, their olive bread is delicious, their food is top.  I have always had a great experience both to go and dining in.

Random days are the best. I was driving outside my usual confines to do a bit of donating.

While on my drive, I noticed a white pickup mirroring my moves. Eventually, I let them draw alongside. The driver was one of you 💕 he threw out a 🤙🏻. I was overjoyed and threw out a ✌️🤙🏽.

Found myself at Cafe Gran Milan and man oh man. This place, hidden from everyone, was packed to the rafters. A long line out the door and not a single unhappy patron.

I met a man and his partner who regaled me with tales of places as good as this. The man runs a bar called Toot’s. If anyone partakes, say hi.

The owner, staff and everyone who comes through these doors seem to be the happiest people on Earth.

I left satisfied wishing I’d found this place years ago.

Amazing food  we got 3 paninis, and they were spectacular, perfectly crispy without being overly crunchy, melty gooey cheese in the inside with good meat to  bread ratio. We also got 3 croissants, 2 filled, 1 plain, all were excellent. The croissants were flakey and buttery and the custard cream was sweet but not cloyingly so.

top_reviews.content: The place was great, my food came out in 5 minutes and was delicious. The guys was supper nice and I will be coming back!

These people know their chicken! Great quality and portion for the price (which is a little bit on the pricier side for a college student, but not really for the city). Honey butter garlic is phenomenal; kbbq galbi is a little too sour for my liking.

Awesome spot. Great food. Maybe my favorite Korean fried chicken in the area. Juicy, strong flavors, boneless, decent portion. Salad with yuzu dressing paired nicely. Always friendly service too. Music was a bit loud last time I went.

Came by on a whim and was pleasantly surprised! We ordered their kimchi fried rice and their sweet and spicy chicken. The food in my opinion tasted great, the chicken was flavorful and the rice had an interesting meaty taste that went well with it. The food didn't take too long and it was piping hot!

Our only complaint is that the chicken came with a tiny scoop of rice, and that the salad was a giant slice of tomato and raw brocoli lol. Otherwise, great spot! Still worth the money to me!
Great fried chicken, the coleslaw was great, just a great experience overall. Service was great and the atmosphere is very nice. Definitely a great place to chill with friends.

top_reviews.content:
Two people, ordered spicy fish noodle soup, sesame peanut sauce noodles, and lamb skewers. Good portion sizes, reasonable prices, tasty flavors, quick and friendly services.
Wished the lamb skewers served with hotter temperature, so the meat would stay tender and juicy longer overtime.

I think it was good but not great!

Service is fast and efficient. You order on a tablet and pay immediately and then get your food (which comes out quickly).

Portions are large. I got the beef noodle soup (not bone-in), and I could barely finish half 😭 The meat portion was generous. The soup was good! Though i feel the noodles felt a bit disconnected from the soup? Like they felt like an after thought (not as hot as the soup was, not as flavorful like they didnt absorb any flavor)

Spicy wontons were totally okay. Weren't particularly juicy nor spicy! Wouldn't get  this again.

I wouldn't wait longer than 20min for this, and I would prefer to try other places in this area (BIGGGG competition for noodle soup)

Found this gem through Yelp and waited in line for about 15 mins on a Saturday afternoon to get seated. This place usually has a long line of people queuing up, and understandably so, since the food was totally worth the wait! We each got the cabbage and fish noodle soup along with wontons for the table. The pickled cabbage rendered a nice sourness to the otherwise rich meat broth. The noodles had the perfect texture and bite. The fish was well seasoned however not very plentiful. The portion size was good but I would've liked more fish in the soup. The wontons were good too. The staff was attentive and the ambience was casual dining.

*Fyi before leaving a review I do try places 2 times prior to making a review* Love the noodle soup here. Everytime I am in Berkely I always stop here hungry or not. Its a small hole in the wall restaurant with very small tables that are cramped together. Its a nice place but the lack of room takes away from it. Wait times vary depending on what time you get there. Also, customers are very close by, standing in line staring at their phones or at you wating their turn to finally sit down. You order and pay on a tablet once seated.  After trying almost everything on the menu, my go to is just the Beef noodle soup, spicy broth and thick noodles. It does not lack flavor and is never overly salty. The beef is always tender and noodles have the right amount of chew and taste fresh. On the side, the house wontons in chili sauce. A little salty and not really spicy in my opinion but flavorful with a good chew from the dough. Can be a little loud but once your food arrives I have noticed people stop talking to their companions and just eat. Good sign. This place is has always consistently good.

Wow wow wow this place was so good!!!! They have one clearly labeled vegetarian noodle dish and it tasted so good. Full of vegetables and the noodles were perfect. I’m definitely going to come back multiple times here.

The oil spilling noodles were unique but could have had more veggies. Note that it’s also a little spicy.
Will definitely be coming back to this place for more 😋

The best Sichuan cuisine in the East Bay area. The quality, portion size, location, and cleanliness are well worth the higher price compared to restaurants in Oakland Chinatown. We have dined here many times and have never been disappointed. Every dish is delicious, authentic, and fresh. We enjoyed everything we ordered, and the portions are so generous that the leftovers easily made two more meals at home.

*Authentic* and delicious food with generous portions and great value. Everything we ordered was flavorful, and the service was excellent! We couldn’t finish all the food, and the leftover packing was done very thoughtfully. Highly recommend!!

Like most Chinese restaurants Sichuan style has a very large menu. The restaurant has lots of seating and is rarely full, which is nice. Most of what I’ve had here has been excellent, but I was not as big a fan of the fried rice. It was heavier with stronger flavors than I typically like. The staff was very fast and helpful, and the portions were huge. And they give kimchi!

I highly recommend and have been 4 times. Green beans are perfect, potsticker wrappers are homemade, scallion pancakes are fried, and fried rice has excellent flavor and lean bits of pork. I have since had the vegetarian fried rice and it's my favorite, there were even bamboo shoots in it. We usually get sweet and sour chicken but have also had kung pao chicken. Everything is great, the servings are large enough for leftovers which are almost even better the second time around. The staff is friendly and attentive. The restaurant is clean and bright. Street parking is available every time I've been.

The pizza wow the pizza it was wonderful and really wonderful. I savored every bite of my 2 slides. I wish I lived here and got free pizza every day because I'm a big boy. I can honestly say that Arinell Pizza offers not only delicious pizza but also a warm and welcoming atmosphere. It was a dining experience I truly enjoyed, and I’ll definitely be back.😊😊

top_reviews.content:
I've been coming here for a decade.  Although the prices have literally doubled, this is still probably the cheapest Banh Mi around.  The grilled pork Banh Mi and egg rolls are the usual.

For the longest time this place was cash only.  They've recently started accepting credit!

Flavorful banh mi but they don’t toast the bread so it’s very crispy.  Sometimes it’s been downright just soft.

It’s just a pickup and go type of spot.  Prices for banh mi are very reasonable and marked on the wall menu.  The other hot foods aren’t prices though.  You have to ask or be shocked how fast stuff adds up. Lol

I’ve been ordered sandwiches combinations many times and it was always delicious.  Something was off today 9/1/2026,  when I got my two combination they were old bread and dried.  I’m very disappointed I think I’m going to try different places.

I ordered the # 7, which is supposedly BBQ pork (char-siu), and the #9, supposedly BBQ chicken.

They both contained smaller than expected amounts of shredded proteins. I’m guessing they are made from the advertised protein, but neither of these is flavorful nor even close to what I was expecting to receive. If you’re going to serve shredded proteins, you need to identify them as such on your menu.

I've had Chinese style BBQ pork and Vietnamese style BBQ chicken, both in Bahn mi previously, as they are both a very common filling.

These both failed miserably by comparison.

I would much rather pay more for a sandwich that arrives with the fillings as expected.

Sadly, I won’t be back.
Quick. Affordable. Delicious. What more could you want? The elderly couple who runs this restaurant must be two of the hardest-working people in the Bay Area food industry!

top_reviews.content: Is this Korean food??? Not a single Korean server. No service at all. No plates and extra bowls. The worst kimchi pancake I have ever had. The hotdog is not as good as 明朗時代米熱狗 I will never come back again. Hankki is way better.

Food itself is nice. Not the kind of Korean food I personally love, but the noodles and Korean cheese dogs have good textures. They use the same noodle in the japchae as in the soup so it isn't like I'm used to, but it was better than most japchae I've had with good sesame oil.

They are popular for their kimchi fried rice, but takeout of that is a fair bit smaller than eating in the resturant.

Order at a kiosk and pick up from a counter. Drop off your plates and you have to sort your food waste and plates yourself. That considered, it's not as cheap as I thought it would be, but was not expensive by any means. Kimchi stew with a japchae side of just under $15 is totally fair.

Not sure if I would personally come back, but it's good for groups because no one really dislikes it and it is solid for takeout.

The korean corn dogs are really good. Do not get the potato tornado it is 90 percent fried and 0 percent potato. Also do not get Hotteok they are also like 100 percent fried and 0 filling. I would only recommend for their Korean corn dogs. I was really disappointed with the other things.

I tried placing an order through a delivery service and I had questions about their menu so I gave the restaurant a call. They answered and a nice lady picked up the phone. I asked my question. She seemed to not hear what I was saying or maybe didn’t understand what I was asking and said hold on while she went to go get someone. My favorite restaurant in Berkeley!

Just a great spot for great food.

I'm a native New Yorker who's been living in CA for over 20 years.  I know good pizza.  The Bay Area has some great pizza places and I like to try them all.  This place was a big let down.  If you like Domino's pizza, you might like it.  I won't be back.

This place is SUCH a perfect neighborhood gem and awesome for everything from family dinners to date nights. We have never felt so welcomed to a decent restaurant with our three very young kids in tow. And the food is always superb.

The food here was soo delicious!! We ordered the Ancient Grain Cheese Cannelloni and the Pennoni alla Norma (with Pennoni subbed for a very nice, soft Tagliatelle). The crepes in the Cannelloni were just the right amount of crispy, the Sheep milk ricotta had a very nice unique flavor, and the tomatoes were so well cooked and flavorful. Everything worked together so well! And the eggplant in the Pennoni alla Norma literally melted in your mouth leaving just the flavor of pure eggplant goodness. Paired with a very nice tomato garlicky sauce, and the very soft pasta noodles, it was also a very comforting dish. My girlfriend and I were both very impressed with both dishes! The serving sizes were also enough to leave us very filled after both dishes, and the prices were appropriate for the quality and amount of food.

Being vegetarian, I was very happy to see the wide variety of vegetarian options as main entrees on the menu. At many places, I've found that the vegetarian options are basically the non-vegetarian options with meat removed, but the vegetarian options here all felt like very complete and intentional meals designed to be had as is.

The service was also phenomenal. Our waitress was very nice and was patient in giving us recommendations. And at the end, one of the other ladies gave us a very passionate and interesting lesson on the history of Sicilian cuisine and how it is influenced by so many different cultures!

Cozy Italian restaurant in North Berkeley with great service! There was a good selection of pizzas, salads, and pastas. The interior is on the smaller side with a cozy feel. My friend and I ordered a combo pizza and the norma pasta to share and we both had enough left over to take home. Didn’t feel like it was especially unique or a “wow” factor, however.

The balls are covered in their red sauce with provolone and Grana Padano, which gives it that nutty and salty flavor that pairs extremely well with the meatballs and baguette. All the juices and cheese just get soaked up to perfection. The baguette bread they use is supplied by La Farine, which is just a few meters away from each other. Just putting out there that La Farine is hands down one of the best bakeries in Oakland, so it makes sense that this sandwich would be so dang good. I’ll be honest that I’m not a big fan of the chips or those chips in general and could be fine with just the sandwich. If you are going to have any sandwich to eat here first, I would highly recommend you try “The Balls” because I promise you will be not disappointed.

After receiving a flyer for this pizza place, I thought I'd give it a try. I love Indian food and I love a good pizza. On a very naan bread crust, Namaste pizza makes tandoori, curried, marsala, spicy mash-ups. I am definitely going to return and try other pizzas.

The menu had so many options that sounded good and we were trying to figure out a way to do a half and half - couldn’t do it on DoorDash, but when ordering directly from their website they have a half and half option!
We got the chicken pizza masala and combination pizza 🍕 if you’re Indian and know of Nirula’s pizza, this comes so close to being that good. We enjoyed both halves of the pizza with pepper flakes, and would recommend the half and half if you want to try different ones because these pizzas are pretty big

Usually I don’t go for anything other than a thin crust but this medium cheese was one of the best easy access neighborhood pizza I’ve had in all different cities. I can't say I can compare this to Cheeseboard, but you know, it's local, non-mega franchise, and pretty good. The crust was slightly fried with the juicy fat from the cheese. The bread had quality. I shouldn’t be indulging due to pandemic inches but this was well worth it.

Very good pizza. Had a ton of toppings, which was nice as a lot of times pizza places skimp on the toppings. Flavours were very good and the pizza was cooked perfectly. But the Ranch was the best part. I love good ranch with my pizza. And this one really hit the spot! Overall a very good place.

top_reviews.content: The staff were so amazing and attentive, but not overbearing. The food was delicious. I was very pleased to see they had a nice vegan/vegetarian menu and the drinks were unforgettable.

The sweetest couple, Atul & Alka treated us like family the day we wandered into Tigerlily. Alka went above and beyond to create the perfect espressos martinis for us and even ordered the Mr. Black liqueur that we liked knowing we were coming back in the following day.
Atul, the husband was so friendly and warm towards us and we could tell their staff was treated well too. Lorenzo, the bartender was just as fun and friendly as the owners.
Now onto the food…Wow!! My boyfriend and I fell in love with the couple of items we ordered. The meatballs and the chicken tikka masala were both absolutely delicious!! Also, the previous day we ordered the veggie samosas and I think it was the most delicious thing I’ve ever tasted.
Sadly, we had prior dinner plans down the street otherwise we would have stayed for a full meal. We also tried the Hibiscus Me and the East of Infinity cocktails and both were amazing!
We live in Napa but are excited to make the drive back to explore the entire menu and share more conversation with the amazing owners and staff. Thank you Atul & Alka!!
Absolutely delectable food, amazing cocktails. The owners and staff all show so much care. The lamb vindaloo is my go to, but everything we have tried is top notch.

Food ranged from good to excellent, but the cocktails were the real star of the show. The drinks menu was extensive, and we enjoyed each one we tried (their namesake, the Tigerlily, was a standout). The fresh fruit is a decadent touch to the very flirty, very sweet cocktails.

The fried chicken was exceptional, with an interesting take on mashed potatoes underneath — very hearty and filling. The coconut curry chicken was also excellent, though the naan was unusually thick and dry.

We also had the beet salad, which was delicious except for the avocados — they were so unripe that I couldn’t cut them with my fork and knife. Not exactly sure how they ended up on a plate and served, but the service was somewhat spotty so we couldn’t send them back before our entrees arrived — not the end of the world, since the beets and paneer were still good.

Overall, the food was good enough to warrant a return visit sometime, and the vibe was sophisticated (if not a bit sports-bar-y in the front). Great for a date night or a special catch-up with friends.
the chicken tikka masala with rice and garlic naan was fantastic. their tigerlily drink was so good, as well as their espresso martini.

reviews_snippets.content: "Great cocktails, indian-fusion food, and friendly staff!"
"This place obviously offers top notch service, in and out of the restaurant."

top_reviews.content:
Let me start by saying that my son and I found this spot by accident, and he looked it up on Google review and said it looked good! Now, living in California we tend to take Mexican food for granted but in reality it's hard to find a place that has exceptional Mexican cuisine. The menu is relatively small but what's on there really packs a punch!
The inside is light and airy giving you the feeling you could be on the coast and not in a... Well to be honest, kind of a hetchy-sketchy part of Berkeley. But I digress, the inside is very simple but upscale feeling and I love the tall ceilings and skylights. Our server Luis was extremely friendly and the service was fast but we never felt rushed. My son had the spicy pork tacos which he said were great, and I had the chicken verde enchiladas which also were phenomenal! We skipped dessert because we had started with an appetizer that was delicious but really way too much for two. What a delightful accident finding this place, I think it's safe to say we have a new favorite!
The Superb-intendent 🍀

Tasty, flavorful but not heavy Oaxaqueño food in a high ceiling elevated environment.

The drinks were lively but harmonious. The Tuna Tostado was sooo light and good. You could easily just order appetizers. But come as four people if you can so you can share. For two people it would be a romantic outing.

Service was excellent but unobtrusive.

We loved this place! So much seating and good vibes. Food was delicious! We ordered the chicken tacos, chicken enchiladas, a drink. Everything tasted fresh and was brought out very quick. For dessert we had the flan which was rich and hit the spot. We will definitely be back soon!

Had an amazing experience at Mercado 925 while visiting Berkeley. The food was excellent — incredibly authentic Mexican flavors with a modern approach that made every dish feel thoughtful and elevated. The drinks were outstanding, the music and overall vibe were perfect!

Nicole and Jose took such great care of us all night. Super sweet, attentive, and genuinely welcoming.

If you’re in Berkeley, this hidden gem is a must. We’ll absolutely be back!

Wow, just wow.  We lucked into this place...Just looking for a place to eat and found this on Google Maps.  Great venue.  Beautiful interior.  Great wait staff.  And then the food!!!  Try the tuna tostadas (ask for extra tostados).  My Al Pastor tacos were terrific!  Corn tortillas, lots of meat, Great salsa on the side.

name: Bird & Buffalo
address: 4659 Telegraph Ave, Oakland, CA 94609, United States

google.name: Bird & Buffalo
google.address: 4659 Telegraph Ave, Oakland, CA 94609, United States
google.description: Welcoming neighborhood outpost offering Thai curries & grilled meats in bright, chic environs.

top_reviews.content: This is a delicious Thai family owned spot in the Temescal. The food is Issan from Northwestern Thailand. Their specialty is larb - a delicious sort of ground meat (or mushroom & tofu) dish eaten with lettuce wraps and dipping sauce. We’ve also enjoyed the drunken noodles with ground chicken. They have a cool box set for $23 which is enough for two for lunch! It includes larb, choice of protein and green beans. And they have lots of curries!

I ran into this place during Covid and got hooked since. The food is exceptional, I don’t think I have tried anything I didn’t like here. The service also always friendly and attentive. My go-tos are Gai Gra Pao and Drunken Noodles. If you feel adventurous, the chicken heart skewers are delicious. If you can’t tolerate spicy, make sure to make it very clear.
I ate the best chicken wing of my life here. So crisp on the outside, so moist on the inside. Even if you go only to try the chicken wing, it'd be worth a trip.

A small Thai restaurant with a Thai street style.
The food was surprisingly delicious, even the simple papaya salad was great! Their Roti is very different, they put the topping on top instead of dipping it in sauce!

The tables are close together , maybe when it’s full house will not easy to talk with each others !

Overall the food is delicious but nothing that was phenomenal that would warrant me to go out of the way for unless I’m in the area EXCEPT that the fried chicken spring roll and Kao Ka Moo was tasty.

Chicken spring roll has outer layer that was not the usual spring roll and so it gives a nice texture to the meaty spring roll.

The Kao Ka Moo, stewed pork belly, was so tender that it just shreds and the flavor was yummy. This was the entree that we pretty much finished since it was yummy.

Pad see ew was so so. A little on the soggy side which I’m not used to and I prefer pad see ew from another location about 1 mile away that is hands down the best I’ve had.

Nam Kao was ok too.  Texture was lacking since everything was mostly soggy when I’ve like the crispy rice texture together with all the meat and vegetables.

Kao soi had good coconut milk soup but it didn’t have that spices depth to it. If it did, it would have been perfect, just as how I would remember it when I had it in Thailand.

reviews_snippets.content: "This place is small & cute with community seating & a uniquely street Thai menu."

top_reviews.content: As others have mentioned, it’s still a good spot, but there’s definitely room for improvement. We ordered two cheeseburgers and Brussels sprouts. The food arrived quickly, and the server was really friendly and attentive. The food was "good" but not exceptional. We didn’t mind since we were looking for a quick bite and really enjoyed the service and ambiance, but we probably wouldn’t return specifically for the food.

Impressive building with high ceilings and comfortable seating, both inside and out. I went alone but this would definitely be a good place for group gatherings. Vegetarian options available. I had the veggie burger, which itself was great, and it came with a liberal portion of fries. Will certainly be back.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience was too uncomfortable to ignore.
My friend and I (two young women) were at a table with a pitcher of beer and I went to the bar to ask for a glass. The bartender, Joey, stared at me like I was crazy before asking for my ID — which is completely fine — but his demeanor was immediately hostile. Because of how rude the interaction was, my friend calmly asked if we had done something to upset the staff. His became more aggressive and told my friend “I won’t serve you!” For the rest of the night, he made faces at us, smiling and waving sarcastically from behind the bar.

At the end of the night, when we tried to speak to another bartender about what happened, Joey aggressively yelled across the bar, “Do you have something to say to me?” It was intimidating and completely inappropriate. As we were leaving, he continued glaring and making hostile faces. The other bartenders were kind and professional, and encouraged us to leave a review. Unfortunately, the manager was dismissive.
This was openly aggressive behavior that bordered on harassment. We did nothing to warrant it, and it made us uncomfortable for the rest of the night. Completely unacceptable.
Great range of beers and cocktails, good food, the staff are really friendly and helpful, there's plenty of outdoor seating in the quad behind the main bar. But it is LOUD.

This place was solid. It's just really far out there to get to for me so I had never visited before. The wings were good but a little overpriced. The alcohol selection was good and the food had a lot of variety. The bar set up seemed awkward and a nuisance for the 1 bartender that had to go from one spot to the other to get different kinds of beer from the tap.

top_reviews.content: I come to the area about 2 times a month and for some reason I crave Pho. This is the 3rd Vietnamese location I have tried and it is my favorite! It checks all my boxes. I love how beautiful and bright it is inside, the food is delicious and they have a great fresh juice drink list. I usually just get the Pho with rare beef because the broth is so delicious ! And I get Red Alert juice. Everything is so fresh. I love coming here. I also love that there is outside seating for people with dogs.

I had the pumpkin curry and coconut rice and they were both incredible. Really rich, flavorful curry with big chunks of dark meat chicken and cozy vegetables. The rice was so fragrant and sweet. I ordered pickup and it was ready super fast.

This place is absolutely phenomenal! I got the chicken pho, which had a marinated chicken option. Soup broth was very tasty. My husband got the banh mi combo, which comes with a broth soup and an imperial roll. They also have a nice juicer and makes refreshing fruit/veggie juices to round the meal out. I got the Refresher juice which has cucumber, Apple, mint. Service was great too! A lot of natural light in the restaurant. Good vibes.
Eggplant tofu is pretty good here, nice and caramelized in that clay pot. The cheesecake stuffed dessert roll thing was so nice too. If I were to go here again it would be for that!

First time here, I had the No. 46 "Sizzling Shaking Beef" and Coconut rice, the Banh Mi Combo after we had No. 2 Crispy Vegetarian Rolls. The food was served quickly and the Beef still "Sizzling" on the Fajita Skillet! All delicious!

reviews_snippets.content: "I ordered a pot of delicious tea, a bowl of veggie broth and the tofu salad."

name: Pyeong Chang Tofu Berkeley 버클리 평창 순두부
address: 1269 University Ave, Berkeley, CA 94702, United States

top_reviews.content:
One of the best Korean meals we’ve had! The kimchi seafood jjigae was easily the highlight—super flavorful with lots of fresh seafood and a rich, tangy broth. We also loved the kimchi jeon, which was perfectly crispy without being greasy, and the bibimbap, which was fresh and even better with the house gochujang.

The doenjang jjigae with pork was delicious and comforting, especially with the nurungji on the side—the crispy rice paired so well with all the stews. All of the banchan tasted fresh and homemade, especially the kimchi and sweet potato.

The service was also fantastic. Everyone was friendly, and the food came out surprisingly fast. We’ll definitely be back!

The kimchi pancake was crispy and flavorful, the bibimbap came out perfectly sizzling, and the tofu soup was rich and comforting. They also give everyone complimentary japchae to try, which was such a nice touch, and the banchan spread was huge. Generous portions, great flavors, and definitely a spot I’d come back to!!! 😋
Great service, atmosphere, and freshest kimchi and side dishes. The best for me was the Soy  garlic chicken wings and tofu soup. Will definitely be my go to spot when I'm craving Korean food.

Very family friendly. We rolled in with 3 kids and two adults at 5p and they were able to put us in a room area on our own so the kids could go a little wild. Great foresight on their side.

Excellent side dishes (even got extra fishcake). The non-spicy food eater in our group loved the mung bean pancakes (even more than the delicious fried chicken). Really happy with our visit and am happy to go as much as I can.

The crispy rice is such a nice, delicious touch.

I love Pyeong Chang Tofu house. The service is excellent and I keep coming back for authentic Korean food. My favorite dishes are the Bossam, Korean fried chicken, and of course the tofu soup. I also love the simple but flavorful side dishes (banchan) that you get with your meal.

There is something about the authentic flavor that keeps me coming back. The owners and staff are always friendly and welcoming. Time to head back and try more of the menu items like the Naengmyun and Galbi-tang.

top_reviews.content:
We ordered takeout and tried the shredded chicken noodle soup and the pork & shrimp vermicelli. I personally preferred the pork & shrimp vermicelli. It came with grilled shrimp and BBQ pork, and the flavors were bright and refreshing, especially with the hints of lemongrass or mint.

I found a lot of people were ordering the chicken noodle soup, so I wanted to give it a try. But it didn't live up to my expectations. The chicken was very dry and tough to chew. While the broth was fragrant, I wouldn't order this dish again.

Visiting family and friends in the area. So we tried this place out, we ordered vermicelli chicken bowl, the chicken was pre-made, warmed up in the microwave/under a heat lamp or warm oven, sent it back to the kitchen asked for fresh chicken to be cooked. The worst part is they cooked the new chicken and just added it on top of the old chicken. Broken rice with grilled pork but changed the order to combination pho, the pho light beef broth more of northern style beef broth, the jalapeños were sliced in the morning or day before you could tell by the film on it, bean sprouts were fresh, basil so/so, it's was ok, grilled pork sandwich, on the sandwich they forgot about it, I had to go up to the counter and asked for it. When you go a restaurant you want food made to order not sitting around because the meat ends up dried and less flavor, I dont think I have ever been to a vietnamese restaurant that does this (pre-make the meat) and I don't understand how it was rated 4.9 that tell me people here does not know good the vietnamese food here.

Oh my god this is fantastic food. Genuinely, 200%, stunning out-of-this-world food. We're traveling for my niece's quincé, and after 5 hours on a plane and no sleep, I have never in my entire life been more grateful that I told my fiancé "Hey, you usually like pho, there's a place with a fun name that serves it", because I am CONVINCED that we have struck 500% gold. Staff is incredibly friendly, atmosphere is FANTASTIC, and I cannot do the food justice in words, but it's incredibly fresh and the flavor is impeccable. I can and will try to beeline here again for lunch if circumstances allow it.

Finally found the veggie pot I’d been looking for — full of flavor, a generous amount of tofu, and a real mountain of vegetables. The portion was so large I had to take half of it to go.

A nice surprise: complimentary homemade ginger tea and hot sauce, both excellent.

Total came to $17, which is great value for the quality and quantity.

Solid 5 ⭐️

This is my second time eating Vietnamese food in SF, and OMG, I’m really happy — the food is so good!
1.	The Gỏi cuốn (Vietnamese fresh spring rolls) is amazing, delicious, and very well served 🤤
2.	The Bún thịt nướng (Vietnamese grilled pork vermicelli bowl) is delicious, and the portion is big enough for two people.

top_reviews.content: Came here for the first time winter break at UCB. The staff treated me like I was the only person in the world (I was the only in the restaurant), but extremely professional and attentive. Serving warm water is such a nice touch I wish more places offered. I ordered the spring rolls and the pad Thai. Both absolutely fresh and delicious. Potions are very generous. I will be back here, and brining my friends!

Came in here for a late night meal. I wasn’t expecting the inside to look so fancy haha. Great atmosphere and the waiter was really friendly despite the hour. The clear noodle soup was easy on the stomach yet extremely flavorful — lots of white pepper and other seasonings so I didn’t need to use any additional sauces. Tons of noodles and delicious chicken as well. It was exactly what I needed after a long day :)

I was staying at the Holiday Inn and they say that this option was "kinda good."  They were much larger than I expected, with a great menu, and wonderful service.  That was the best Pad Thai I'd ever had!  It was completely empty for most of my meal; they should be doing better business!

I was delivered food from here that had a small rock in it. It chipped my tooth. When i called to tell them and ask how they’ll fix it, they told me to call uber support for a refund??? Because it was delivered through uber eats (their own website has a delivery option which does not work). They did not offer to help in any other way. Stay away!!

I had Pra Ram with chicken and Chicken Satay. It was absolutely delicious. What I appreciate it most is that they gave plenty of peanut sauce. A lot of Thai restaurants skimp on the sauce, but not this one. I also enjoyed the authentic environment of the restaurant. The restroom left something to be desired in the way of cleanliness, but I didn't let it take away from my enjoyment of this experience.
