top_reviews.content: This is really a hike in the wall! Lovely atmosphere, boutique like setting (since the max capacity is prob 25 pax?). Everything we ordered is so delicious and beautifully presented. I love the sake too. The sashimi is very fresh and I would definitely recommend that if u plan on dinning here.

Butterfish is in a league of its own—simply the single greatest sushi experience I have ever had. From the moment we walked in, the staff brought incredible warmth, authenticity, and passion to the table, taking the time to explain every single dish in rich detail.

Every item on the menu hit a home run:

Albacore Melody ($19.00): Remarkably fresh, perfectly balanced, and melted in the mouth.

Island Scallops ($19.00): Delicately sweet with an unbeatable, velvety texture.

Escolar Tapa ($15.95): Rich, buttery perfection—easily one of the standout bites of the night.

Sushi and Sashimi 12-piece ($59.00): A masterclass in knife work and quality. Every piece was exceptionally fresh and thoughtfully presented.

Kani Real Crab Handroll ($10.95): Generously stuffed with real crab that truly shone through.

Sapporo ($6.95): Crisp, cold, and the ideal pairing to round out an unforgettable meal.

I honestly never realized just how incredible a dining experience like this could be. Butterfish has officially set the bar so high that it has completely ruined sushi anywhere else for me. If you are in Berkeley, do yourself a favor and eat here!

This place is incredible in food, service, and atmosphere. Such amazing quality fish and delicious dishes.

My favorite was their hand rolls and the hirame usuzukuri (like a carpaccio). Even their green tea was made well, not bitter at all - so smooth. I dont think you could get anything wrong here.

Came here last-minute looking for a good sushi place, and it was amazing. Atmosphere was indeed omakase-esque as other reviews state, really small and intimate. Sat at the bar and watched the chef at work, which I would highly recommend. I don't think you would go wrong at all ordering anything off the menu, everything we had was delicious. Portions on the salmon avocado roll were large, and there was never any padding for space in a roll with extra rice... just more fish. A bit on the pricey side, but very much worth it and really close to the best sushi I've had.
Best Sushi Experience and Fish quality ever! Highlight in Berkeley! This is a restaurant you should not miss! Amazing people, atmosphere and food!!!

top_reviews.content: Quick and affordable made to order onigiri with vegan/plant based options. I like the spicy tofu triangle, the teriyaki tofu and the kimchi tofu triangles are good as well. They usually throw in complimentary edamame if you get a few, and they have other options as well. More of a grab and go atmosphere but they are fast and friendly to me, and the condiment section is loaded with good stuff like free sesame seeds, teriyaki sauce, Japanese spice, Sriracha, shoyu etc. I like this for a nice light meal for some protein and energy after a work out or so.
Fantastic flavors and a great deal. Loved the chicken teriyaki and the miso soup.

Ive been coming here for years. My favorites are the spicy tofu/ grilled salmon/ ahi tuna triangles/onigiri. They also have an ahi tuna plate (over rice) which i get as well. If you get a set of 3-4 onigiris it comes with edamame. My orders have always been made quickly and prices are affordable.

In all my travels, I look for what I call "happy food."  Happy food for me is healthy, nutritious, tasty, nicely prepared, and served by smiling people in a clean environment.  Oori exceeded all my happy food requirements and then took me for a ride through food blissfulness with each bite.  I had chicken teriyaki, grilled salmon, and spicy tuna triangles.  On the side, I complimented it with miso soup and ginger. Each flavor was distinct and made my taste buds ooh, ahh, and wow for more.  I'll be back here for more without question. I felt like I was dining at a 5-star restaurant and found the food reasonably priced.

The double unagi rice triangle features large pieces of unagi.   The short rib plate is not really short rib but small bites of beef nuggets.  I prefer edamame boiled rather than wok fry as the edamame tends to be greasy with wok fry.

Casa Barotti is a lovely family owned Peruvian-Italian restaurant with delicious food, cozy vibes, and friendly service. I ordered the pesto rigatoni with chicken milanesa, and for me, the chicken was the star! Great flavor and texture.

First time having pizza focaccia and they are incredible! Will definitely be back if I'm in the area. Plenty of tables and the staff are very nice.

Mushroom & sausage focaccia - fluffy soft with crispy edges, garlicky, and full of flavor.

The service is wonderful and the dining area is very cute and clean! Prices are reasonable. Will come back for dinner and drinks at some point!
We love the pizzas! They also have a great roast chicken, which makes for a delicious family dinner. Ingredients are high quality and the atmosphere is sweet.

4dreams in the East Bay Area offers an incredible blend of Nepali and Indian cuisine, with each dish bursting with authentic flavors. The cozy atmosphere enhances the dining experience, making it perfect for gatherings. Definitely a must-visit for food lovers seeking something unique

WOW!  Just WOW!  We were in town for a show and this restaurant showed up with great reviews and seemed to offer some different options.  It was AWESOME.  I'm a little burnt out on curry because I've been cooking a lot myself lately and so decided to go with the Nepalese options.  Just wonderful. My partner had Nepali Thali and she raved...said it was one of the best Thali she's ever had. We met the owner...super nice and humble guy.  The service was impeccable and very attentive. top_reviews.content:
Absolutely Phenomenal Pizza & Vibes!

If you are looking for the absolute best pizza in Berkeley, look no further than Red Tomato Pizza House. From the moment you walk in, you're treated like family, and that's all thanks to the incredible owners, Buler and Go. They are some of the most welcoming, cordial, and genuinely friendly people you will ever meet, and their passion for what they do completely shines through in the food and the atmosphere.
The food itself is spectacular, starting with a crust that is perfectly executed to give you that ideal, authentic crunch with just the right touch of char. It’s never overly doughy, providing the perfect base for their fresh ingredients. You can instantly taste the quality of their top-tier three-blend mozzarella cheese and toppings that are prepared fresh in-house daily. Whether you are looking for a killer combination pizza, a smoky BBQ chicken pie, or need excellent gluten-free or vegan options, they have completely mastered it all.
To top it all off, the place is incredibly clean, the service is lightning-fast, and they have an awesome beer selection to pair with your meal. On the weekends, the downtown location is perfect for catching great live music right outside. Buler and Go have built a true gem in Berkeley with incredible food, wonderful hospitality, and a warm, homey feel. I’ll definitely be a frequent regular here!
Ordered a pizza to be delivered... vegan BBQ. It arrived almost completely uncooked. Dough was raw and even cold. Inedible, and for $50.

I had a really disappointing experience here. I ordered a calzone and garlic knots, and almost immediately after eating them I started feeling sick to my stomach. Within a short time I had to rush to the bathroom and ended up throwing up. It was honestly a terrible experience.

Beyond that, the food itself was not good at all. The calzone and garlic knots tasted very bland and seemed very unfresh. There was almost no flavor, and the texture made it seem like the ingredients had been sitting around for a while rather than being freshly prepared.

When you’re paying for restaurant food, you expect it to at least taste fresh and be made with quality ingredients. Unfortunately this was the complete opposite of that. The whole experience left me feeling sick and extremely disappointed.

I rarely write negative reviews, but people should know what they might be getting. I definitely will not be returning.

Absolutely delicious!! This was my second time coming here and I got a 10 inch cheese pizza both times and it was wonderful! The ingredients are fresh and honestly just taste really good. The staff is also really nice! 10/10 amazing!

I ordered a pizza & potato skins to go. We ordered the combination pizza. Oh my goodness! I regretted not ordering a bigger pie. It was so good! The sauce,  it too zingy or acidic or overpowering ( my pet peeve) We will definitely come back & order the other flavors. The potato skins were delicious. The only thing I suggest for those is to add a sprinkle of chives and to have the option of sour cream or ranch for dipping. The food was excellent. One of the best pizzas I have ever had! Thank you!

top_reviews.content:
What a great little find in Berkeley! Cali Alley is tucked away in an alley with a cool, laid-back atmosphere and some seriously good food.

We tried the Chef’s Burger, fried chicken sandwich, mac & cheese, and fries, and everything was fantastic. The Chef’s Burger was the standout for me. A juicy brisket burger piled high with hickory-smoked tri-tip, Swiss cheese, crispy onions, pepperoncini, and Thousand Island aioli. Definitely not your average burger! The combination of flavors and textures really worked. The fried chicken sandwich was crispy and flavorful, the mac & cheese was rich and creamy, and the fries were just as good.

What I really liked about Cali Alley is that they take familiar comfort food and give it their own creative twist without overcomplicating things. You can tell there’s some real thought and care behind the menu. The portions are generous, the ingredients taste fresh, and the whole place has a fun, unpretentious neighborhood feel.

Love discovering spots like this. We’ll definitely be back to explore more of the menu. Highly recommend!

Cali Alley is a fantastic spot that’s well worth checking out. One of the things I appreciated most is the variety on the menu—there are plenty of great choices for all tastes, including a solid selection of vegan and vegetarian options.

A couple of things to know before you go: there isn’t a restroom on-site. It’s not a deal breaker by any means, but it’s something to keep in mind. Also, our food took a little while to be prepared, but once it arrived, it was clear the wait was absolutely worth it.

The portions are generous—don’t be surprised if you’re taking home leftovers in a to-go box. Everything we ordered was packed with flavor and incredibly satisfying. The Chef Burger was so good it should honestly be called the “Chef’s Kiss Burger.” The Mac n Cheese is to die for, rich and comforting in all the right ways. And the Mint Limeade was the perfect refreshing complement to the meal—absolutely delicious.

Whether you choose to dine in or order delivery, you won’t be disappointed. Plus, you’re supporting a great small business that clearly takes pride in serving quality food. Highly recommended!

i’ve been going here for years! delicious food! they’ve expanded their menu a lot and i’m really enjoying it. they’ve got options for gluten free and vegetarian too. one of my favorite things about cali alley is that it’s outdoors and dog friendly. such a cute place. staff are very nice too.

i love their prawn bao buns. their mac and cheese and loco moco are also really tasty. eventually i’ll try everything on the menu!

I ordered the chicken and waffles with habanero salsa and it was exquisite. The food came out nice and hot (probably made to order by the sounds of the kitchen?) and was packed with flavor. Well seasoned, cooked beautifully, and not greasy at all. I'm excited to come back and try other offerings on their menu.

*Note that it's outdoor seating only

A cute little corner stop that's full of flavor, and you'd never guess it! This burger had it all, and then some. I'm talking about the chef's burger of course. It was nice and juicy, cooked to perfection (medium being my preferred temperature), and the best part was that there was a surprise pickle! The fries were seasoned well too. House ranch also was a nice touch. We'll be back. Maybe tomorrow.

top_reviews.content: A family friend invited me there and said, “it will be the best meal of your life”. I thought he was joking. He wasn’t. He had ordered lamb shank for us. Apparently you have to order in advance as it takes a few hours to prepare. It was truly incredible. I have lived inManhattan for a few decades and have eaten in top Michelin starred restaurants as well as hole in the wall Pakistani/Indian joints. This lamb shank was heavenly. Only thing i would change is to add option of byob. Would be awesome to be able to bring your wine to dinner here

Warm plates, warm food, warm people
Complimentary chicken hot and sour soup, complimentary tea.

Very tasty and fresh food, this restaurant does not use any frozen ingredient.

Very reasonable priced with most dishes being in $14-$20 range, given that the soup is complimentary as well as the tea, incredible value and taste at $14-$20.

The food service is quick, clean and warm - they even have a warm plate, in winter this is such a nice touch to get food in a warm plate.

The ambiance is cozy, warm home-like, clean and professional.

Very polite staff and owners.

Love that they have a balanced mix of vegetarian and meat-based dishes.

5/5
Really nice mural on the walls, good ventilation, complimentary chai & water, nice staff, the BEST NAAN I HAVE EVER HAD, and great chill music

There are very few restaurants where I find myself venture back to the very next day after trying it for the first time, but Vegan N’ Chicken had me hooked after my first bite.

I was looking for a simple comfort meal after a long day and decided to try a place. It was around 8:30 and most places in the area were closing at 9 but Vegan N’ Chicken happened to be open until 10pm!

When I walked in, I immediately was welcomed with ‘mom and pop’ restaurant vibes. It is a very casual and fairly small restaurant, but it makes for a very comforting experience. You get to seat yourself then they’ll bring you a menu. The menu is simple, but also has everything you’d need. They even have a few seafood dishes! While you wait for your food, you can help yourself to their complimentary soup & hot chai. I’ll admit I have no clue what the soup is, but it is such a great way to start the meal. Especially with some hot chai too!

On day 1 we ordered Lamb Tikka Masala ($14.99), Chana Masala ($9.99), Cheese Naan ($3.99), Rice ($2.99), and Vegetable Samosas ($4.99). The servings were very generous for the price compared to other similar restaurants in Berkeley. We did ask for medium spice level, but it wasn’t spicy enough for us so they brought us a plate of onions, peppers, and cucumbers! The Chana Masala was my favorite bite of the night. It was packed with fragrant spices & the garbanzo beans were so tender. The Lamb Tikka Masala was a little bit sweeter than I am used to, but after mixing in some rice or eating it with the cheese naan it was perfect.

On day 2, we ordered the Papadum ($2.99), Rice ($2.99), Prawn Vindaloo ($17.99), and Chana Masala ($9.99 - we added paneer to it and didn’t confirm how much it was with the paneer). This time we ordered our dishes spicy to see if it was any different. It really was still not spicy at all, but honestly it didn’t bother us. It was a great way to be able to enjoy the dishes in their entirety. The prawns in the vindaloo were fairly large and the portion was perfect for two people! They were also not overcooked & still had a nice bounce when biting into it. The Chana masala with the added paneer was a great combination as well.

Vegan N’ Chicken is honestly a great spot for the college students nearby as well. It’s affordable & could easily be split into two meals even if you just order one dish!

Next time we stop by, we’re going for the biryani!

Discovered the best Indian/Pakistani restaurant in the Berkeley area, and I couldn’t be more impressed. The restaurant was neat and clean, and the owner was incredibly professional and welcoming. He took the time to go over the menu with us and highlight some standout dishes. Our group of six ordered a variety of items, and every single dish was fantastic, with the Gobi Gosht being a particular highlight. You could tell that everything was made with fresh, high quality ingredients, which made a big difference in the flavor. The food was delicious, and the service was outstanding. I’ll definitely be returning for both the amazing food and excellent service. Five stars!

top_reviews.content: Great little spot if you're looking for something more casual than Belotti in Rockridge but with the same excellent taste and high quality! Love that they set up little tables on the sidewalk. My personal favorite is the spaghetti with burrata - a classic that never disappoints.

Incredible pastas that taste like you're actually in Italy. Al dente with flavorful sauces. The pastas are so so so good. Best pasta in the East Bay, for sure. Drinks are simple but great also.

Service here is counter, with the pastas coming out almost instantly. Prices are fair for the quality and quantity.

It's nice to have somewhere good within walking distance, plus it's hard to get into the original location and this is a much more chill dining experience.

Highly highly recommend!

We stopped by Belotti Bottega to look at their fresh pastas and authentic italian offerings. To our delight, we discovered they also prepare warm meals on-site, so we decided to stay and enjoy the experience. We ordered a couple of pasta dishes along with drinks and settled into their outdoor seating on a cool yet sunny winter afternoon.

The service was exceptionally friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home. The food? Absolutely authentic and rich in flavor. We tried the Agnolotti di Lidia and Casoncelli Bergamaschi, and both were outstanding. The pork shoulder and prosciutto in the Casoncelli were especially delicious, while the beef shank-stuffed pasta of the Agnolotti di Lidia left us with clean plates all around.

Belotti Bottega is a gem for anyone craving genuine Italian flavors paired with warm hospitality. Highly recommended for a cozy yet elevated dining experience.

Hands down the best fresh pasta in the East Bay! The quality is incredible, and I love that you can either grab uncooked noodles to make at home or stay for a quick, delicious meal. top_reviews.content: The Monk’s Kettle is my new favorite restaurant in Oakland. This is definitely a hidden gem, and a MUST. We came here to eat the Lamb Shank we once tried and that stuck in our memory forever. And yesterday we realized it was even better than we could remember. The lamb shank was so tender that it could separate from the bone effortless, we did even need to chew it. It was laid on a bed of marinated pickles (pickles with pickled onion or shallots, and black and green olives), and feta cheese with a vinaigrette. On top of the lamb, a tasteful meat Demi-glaze that went along with the vinaigrette and the pickles exquisitely. The demi- glaze is to drink it on its own. It’s simply a genius combination: the acidity of the pickled veggies pairs so good with the fat on the lamb, it helps you clean your palate from the small amount of fat left in the lamb, just genius. But that was not the only good thing in the menu: the mac & cheese was the best we’ve ever tried, and the steak frites was cooked to perfection: pink in the inside, and with a little crust on the outside, simply perfect. The beer selection was also extensive, and the menu included the explanation of every type of beer they have . We will be back soon for sure. In my top list of restaurants in the area.

Unsuspecting from the outside but full of charm inside.

From the old wood bar/tables to the glasses behind the bar, you'll feel welcome.

They have cute kettles sprinkles throughout.

Seating is first come.

Did I mention they have a lot of veggie options and piny the elder on tap?

Server was patient with our group of 5.

Recommend for a spot with brews n food.

What?
Go to Oakland, to a gastro pub, for a lunch with an old friend?
YES - go here, it's fantastic.
1. Parking. Noon on a Thursday afternoon I lucked out and parked on College Ave., just 50 feet from the front door.
2. Service. Greeted as I walked in by a friendly staff person (who was also our waitperson). She was knowledgeable and patient and took our order (2 to stay, and 1 to go) by memory and got it all correct.
3. Food. My buddy and I got the same thing: Pub burger (medium) on brioche bun with gruyere cheese and grilled onions along with a side of kale salad (also could have had chips or fries). Excellent burger although I removed the top bun and ate the burger with a knife and fork. The shocker was the kale salad - no stems, mixed with root vegetables, and dressed with an interesting umami-ish vinaigrette: fantastic. So good, a ordered a full size kale salad to go for dinner later.
4. Dessert. Out of curiosity, I asked for a black coffee, and "do you have any cookies?" thinking maybe some big Costco oatmeal monsters. But, no - they have an in-house cookie plate (a long wooden cutting board with three hand-made cookies: gingerbread chocolate chip, light lemon bar, and a snicker doodle. Hand made by a staff person off premises - wow, really good, fresh, and perfect with robust black coffee.
My buddy and I had a beautiful lunch and sat for awhile talking and enjoying an Arnold Palmer, a black coffee, and cookies - a great mid-day break.
5. Summary: I haven't been to Oakland since the the G.S. Warriors left, but Monk's Kettle is a perfect reason to go back.

Legend has it that the carved wood encasing the shelves behind the bar once framed a (pretty spectacular) fireplace.

A remarkably dynamic selection of beers, foreign and domestic, are served in complementary glassware.  If you enjoy your beer as much as I do, you'll appreciate this level of, well...  appreciation.  🤔

I think none of the dishes were mind-blowing, but just exactly what you'd expect, done right. I'd come again!

top_reviews.content:
I love to eat at Kura Revolving Sushi Bar in Berkeley! I come frequently, as it is definitely a favorite for me, my friends, and my family.

It’s a fun, modern place to eat. The dining area is clean and sunny (with big windows letting the Berkeley sunshine stream in), and I find the conveyor belt that carries the sushi plates and the robot that brings the water and wasabi to the table so cute!

I like how you order by the plate (most plates are $4.10), which means you can have as much or as little as you can afford or feel hungry for. I’ve come here for just a plate or two before, and I’ve also come with friends and accumulated tall stacks of plates. (If you order enough plates, you might even win cute prizes that are dispensed from above the ordering console at every table!)

The environment and concept are wonderful, but the food here speaks for itself. When it comes to sushi, there’s a variety of choices that range from traditional to modern. The fish and meat are always fresh, the rice is always perfectly sticky and well-seasoned, and the nori is always crisp—especially if you order on the console because then it will come straight to your table from the kitchen on a conveyor belt. I particularly recommend the tekkamkai and the negitoro gunkan; I try these two plates almost every time I come, and I come a lot. The wasabi, soy sauce, and ginger are free and high-quality. I love to use plenty of them with my sushi.

There’s also plenty of great non-sushi items, including ramen, udon, and even fries. The miso soup here is warm and soothing, a perfect appetizer, and the beef udon is also a favorite of mine. (I love the slurpy, chewy noodles and the warm broth with the tender beef).

They take dessert as seriously as the main course. You can’t go wrong here, but for dessert, I recommend the warabi mochi, the sesame balls, and the gooey butter cake. Personally, I often find it hard to choose just one.

The menu is not set in stone, and they frequently circulate exciting specials on and off the menu, so it’s usually worth it to browse the entire menu before ordering. I think my favorite special item that’s ever been on the menu is the negitoro maki roll. (Maybe they'll bring it back, but I don't know.)

They also change out their cute prizes, if you’re into that. I have some cute key chains from when we ordered a bunch of plates a while back.

I downloaded their app, so I can receive discounts/coupons from time to time.

Eating here is always a treat!

I had some bad experiences at other Kura locations, so I was a little hesitant to eat over here, but it all turned out great!

I had a reservation and checked in with the staff when we arrived at the restaurant. We still had to wait about another 15 min for our table to be ready. It's not too bad, but I'm not sure what the purpose of making a reservation is if there's still a wait.

All of the sushi tasted better than I expected. The sushi rice held together well, not too gummy, mushy, or overcooked. And the rice was glossy, hydrated, but not too wet or soggy. The ingredients tasted fresh, and I didn't have any stomach discomfort after getting home. Highly recommended!

Made my kids happy with the conveyor and prize experience. I did like the plate disposal experience. Overall, I was disappointed with food, with ramen being the biggest disappointment. The pork slices were not fresh, very chewy, and didn’t taste right. Overall not the best value for portion sizes. If you like gimmicks, this is the place for you!

We ordered their beef chow fun and Teo Chew noodle soup. The beef chow fun portion was huge, very fragrant, and delicious. I wish they could fry it for big longer, so the noodles could have a better texture.

I am definitely guilty of just getting an order of Brussels sprouts and taking it home to eat with a hot bowl of rice. Since it’s such a crowd pleaser, you could even bring it to a potluck!

3/6/2026*
We were craving mac n cheese and came back to try some of their other flavors.

This time we ordered the Kogi Short Rib Mac and the Garlicky Bacon Mac.

Both were delicious. The kogi short rib mac had a sweet flavor from the kogi bbq sauce, along with Gouda, pecorino, scallions, garlic butter, and sriracha. If you like a little kick of heat, this is your go-to.

The garlicky bacon mac came with lots of bacon, garlic gouda, and pecorino. It tasted cheesier compared to the short rib mac. If you are a bacon lover, this is your go-to.

10/14/2024
We discovered Homeroom through a podcast interview with founder, and was surprised to find they're based in the East Bay, so we decided to check it out. We ordered an elote bowl as a starter and the seasonal special BBQ pulled pork mac and cheese. Unfortunately, the elote bowl arrived after the mac and cheese. The corn was soft and sweet, with delicious cheese and pepper powder that added a great kick to the flavor. The BBQ pulled pork mac and cheese was equally impressive—nice and cheesy, with surprisingly juicy pulled pork.

Our new favorite spot in the bay for a mac&cheese craving, which is way too often lately. Unbeatable prices and the creamiest mac. Vegetarian options galore and so many flavours, it’s impossible to choose.
Luckily they have a mac&cheese trio- great for sharing and date nights. That and a glass of wine? Score and score.

Staff and GM Erick are all so friendly and caring, we just wanted to hang out with them! Can’t wait to come back for one of their event nights- what an amazing spot.

Our server was great. We asked for the sausage to go on half of the pizza and they happily obliged. We didn't think about the salad. The server intuited that would be desired and simply put the dried prosciutto for the delicious salad when it came out so my dinner mate could enjoy it just as much as I could. When asked something specific about the wine, she said she was newer & didn't know but would ask someone else. Much appreciated.

If you’re in the neighborhood I think this is a solid option, although it’s not something so special that it’s worth a long trip. I tried The Chloe which I was impressed by the depth of flavor, but I would make some changes. The potato on the pizza is basically hiding and is overwhelmed by the other flavors. I think the potato should be put on top instead of bottom so that it crisps instead of the arugula. The classic pep is a decent pizza but nothing really stood out to me about it. The staff was all friendly and came by to check in multiple times and refill waters often.

Take the warmth of a local community-run kitchen, add in some killer flavors and textures, sprinkle on some coziness from the ample mood lighting and you’ve got the magic that is State Flour Pizza.

I don’t think I could’ve asked for a better experience at State Flour Pizza Co, and that includes the 30 minute wait time for a table. This is the kind of place that hires the neighborhood teens in the summers while still taking the time to source all fresh ingredients.

Consensus for favorite was split between the mushroom-sausage and green goddess pizzas, but the margherita and hot honey pepperoni were almost as good. Apple salad gave some much needed freshness to the table.

This pizza place is as perfect for a family dinner as it is for a first date, and is just as likely to have a table of college friends as it is a post-conference debrief. That’s because it’s designed for the community, so it attracts the community.

Yes, the pizza! Grateful for extra mushrooms instead of sausage!
But rarely do I review a salad: the apple endive salad with frozen/sliced/dehydrated prosciutto…MUAAA! The apples were perfectly sliced thin and the tarragon vinaigrette (not overdressed) with the blue cheese crumble and pistachios were proportioned and balanced to taste not visuals. Will try to recreate at home but next time, I’m…not…sharing!! 😂

Pizza is best straight out of the oven there and the service was actually service. ALL the staff were kind and patient.

[The only thing about the atmosphere was that as cute as the chairs are, bags slip off so please add hooks nearby.]

Such fantastic pizza! The thin crust was perfect—light yet incredibly satisfying. I’ve honestly never seen pizzas so generously loaded with toppings.

My husband absolutely loved his pepperoni and burrata pizza. The Gaia pizza I ordered was a wonderful vegetarian option—full of flavor and beautifully done. We also tried the Ollie without sausage; it was good, but it didn’t quite compare to the thoughtfully crafted vegetarian choice.
The state flour salad was beautifully done too!

All in all, we were extremely impressed and would wholeheartedly recommend this place. 🍕

What an amazing night at Chez Mansour! We went to watch Terga Group, and everything was absolutely wonderful. The music was incredible, the ambiance was vibrant and welcoming, and the food was delicious.

On top of that, the owner is extremely kind and made us feel right at home. You can really feel the passion and care behind this place. A perfect spot for a great evening with live music, good vibes, and amazing food.

Highly recommend, we’ll definitely be back!

Wow a Wine- Bar with 1920’s ambience!

A truly amazing discovery of the hidden jewel of boring Solano..

I got their special wine, not from the menu, and it was mind blowing.
They have live music and entertainment on weekends!
Local regulars are amazingly friendly folks, and don’t forget to ask what is chef special on Thursdays. We will be back !

We went on fine Sunday evening with little to no people around. At first glance, the place had the middle-east charm. Started with my favorite Labneh and multi-wheat pitas/Zaatar which was absolutely amazing. Experimented with Grape leaves mezze which was little on sour side and mild. Then main course of perfectly seasoned grilled lamb chops, scallops kebabs and lamb kebabs. Out of all the tender lamp chops are must try. Roasted potatoes and basmati rice on the side plays well. Ended up with another favorite Baklava (unexpectedly had right sweetness) and tea.

Everything was excellent! Friendly service, AMAZING food and they also have nights with live music! The pomegranate hummus was the best I've ever had. Also, the Chicken Platter with Roasted Potatoes and Falafels were to die for. They also serve beer and wine + have really cute and dog-friendly outdoor seating!

I've walked by a thousand times and finally went in for dinner. My only complaints is that I waited this long to try it. The food was amazing and the service was attentive yet relaxed and we didn't feel rushed. I'll absolutely be going back soon.

top_reviews.content: We were in the area visiting relatives and it was our anniversary, so we wanted to find somewhere nice, and the reviews were right. My wife had the shrimp cocktail, which came with 8 shrimp (she loved it). My entree was the Rack of Lamb, with 2 double-chops, sauteed kale and navy beans. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I can’t recommend Julia‘s Restaurant enough! The food is absolutely wonderful, the service is top-notch, and the atmosphere is wonderfully private — perfect for a date night or a quiet catch-up with friends. Every dish feels carefully prepared, and the staff truly knows how to take care of you. This place is a gem. I’ll definitely be back!

Overall, it was a great experience. The restaurant is inside of a historic hotel and the overall vibe is peaceful. I went by myself and the staff were very attentive.

For my dinner I ordered the corn soup as an appetizer and the mushroom risotto as my main dish. I also ordered the chocolate bread pudding as a dessert. The corn soup needed more seasoning. It was a little bland for liking. The risotto was flavorful and yummy. I will order it again. Their bread pudding was good, however it was a little hard. Overall I give the food, four stars, and the atmosphere and service, five stars.

This was our second time dining here and it was just as good as the first time. Classic French cuisine, nice cocktails, and wonderful service. We were lucky enough to have Tony as our server again this time and he's an absolute gem of a man.

My friend was in town visiting from Tokyo again and specifically requested to dine here, after I took him here last year.

If you're looking for a pleasant spot for a date or to catch up with a long-time friend, this is a lovely place for that purpose. You'll be able to have an actual conversation because it isn't a loud venue and the architecture is lovely.

This review is a bit tardy.  My wife and I had a wonderful anniversary dinner at Julia’s Restaurant in the Berkeley City Club in August.  From the beautiful ambience to the excellent service to the scrumptious food, we give Julia’s high praise.

We went early and enjoyed walking around the historic building “ooh’ing and ahh’ing” over the stunning architecture and ornate detailing everywhere.  Morgan’s Bar & Lounge has the most gorgeous stained glass Tiffany lamps (see photo) that fit the decor well.

Our waiter, Adrian, was friendly, attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and fun.  The food was beyond amazing.  We both had filet mignon (perfectly cooked medium rare) with bearnaise sauce; it was tender and succulent (see photo).  The accompaniments, sweet potatoes and spinach, were all delicious.

We had never been to Julia’s before and now look forward to going there again for another great, special meal.

I was craving Teo Chew noodles, so I placed a take-out order. I got the dry mixed Original Teo Chew noodles with vermicelli noodles. It came with prawns, fish meatballs, pork meatballs, chicken, pork slices, minced pork, and pork kidney. Oddly, the noodles were not fragrant, but the other ingredients tasted great, especially the pork kidney, which was very tender. 12/30/24
I've been a frequent visitor to the Teo Chew noodle place in Oakland, so I was really curious to try Mi. I had the original Teo Chew noodle soup, which comes with prawns, fish meatballs, pork meatballs, chicken, pork slices, minced pork, and pork kidney with vermicelli. We also tried their Pork Kidney noodle soup.

The soup base is clear and rich in flavor, and the texture of the noodles is spot on. The pork kidney was not overcooked and had a great texture. One notable difference compared to the place in Oakland Chinatown is that Mi adds fried minced garlic on top of the noodle soup, which I really liked as it brought an extra layer of flavor to the dish.

However, I understand why some people think it's a bit pricey. They are cash-only, and two bowls of noodle soup came to around $40 before tipping.
New management helmed by the second generation improved everything!  I crave the Teo Chew Style noodles weekly and this place now holds the crown for best in the bay!

I ordered the ox tail chow fun for lunch. The price was high-$25 but I decided to splurge. I liked that the ox tails were cut small so you can easily eat them. A couple of them were cold inside unfortunately. There were not enough noodles considering how much gravy was  on it. The taste was meh… not terrible but not worth $25. The service was very good. If I come back, I would try the soup noodles.

As the kids say  "10/10.  No notes."

Great portions with excellent homemade taste! Staff is friendly and helpful. The chicken broth soup really hit the spot on a chilly day. Had chicken spring roll and grilled pork Banh Mi. Everything tasted great. They have indoor and outdoor seating. Perfect for a quick meal or hangout with friends and family. I would love to come back to try their pho.

The food is top-notch! Served in real fancy ceramic bowls with good quality ingredients. There is also a lovely Buddha statue made out of marble. We spoke to the parent of the owner for about five’s minutes and really liked them. I would return in a heartbeat. 💓

I love this place. Best banh mi hands down. Generous fillings, and attention to detail - even the carrots are amazing! They make their own mayo and paté as well. The bread is specially baked for them, and is the perfect soft-on-the-inside/crispy-on-the-outside loaf that a proper banh mi commands.

My second love there is the "fried egg rolls wrapped in spring rolls." Pure genius of texture and flavor that is the best of both worlds. Oh, that egg roll crunch combined with crisp cucumber and herby goodness, all dipped in a savory sauce! I could eat those every day.

And don't get me started on the pho! I don't get it too often because I end up finishing it all, and it's sleepy time for me about an hour later!

I recommend anything with grilled fish. I'm mainly a pescatarian, so this is what I've tried. My omnivore friends profess their love for the other things on the menu. I've told many friends to go there, and now some of them go sometimes two days in a row!

There is street parking right outside (metered), and you can find free parking around the corner in the residential streets off Gilman. There are both indoor and outdoor seating, the latter an enclosed patio with transparent roofing.

Portions are generous, and there is attention to detail in every ingredient. This is very intentional. I enjoy their posts on social media, too. The only downside to PhoSho is realizing you've taken the last bite!

The guys here that run the place are fantastic! They are really trying to do something special there, and are succeeding at it. When you're there, have a look around at the art - full wall and ceiling murals representing Vietnamese and Asian culture surround you. I feel so at home there!

I am so happy they are here and seem to be doing well! The restaurant was fairly busy.  Would be a great place to meet friends before or after a movie!

They offer their amazing breakfast dishes all day. I always love Eggs Benedict so I ordered it with smoked salmon. Yumm and perfectly cooked, as you can see in the photo after I sliced into the egg.

Other great dishes I've had here - the braised short ribs melt in your mouth. Prime rib, not on the menu right now, was huge and fabulous. Fried chicken and waffle was a bit too healthy for me, ha ha, because of the white meat chicken.

Still one of the top breakfast spots under the radar in the area, excellent presentation really delicious breakfast menu, well made espresso drinks, and super friendly and attentive service.

A mellow spot with friendly and attentive service every time. They have a great classic menu with American staples like Cobb salad, burgers, sandwiches, and pasta dishes. ★★★★★

Jungdon Katsu has become one of my favorite places to eat. The food is so good that I keep telling myself I'll take a photo before I start eating, but I never make it that long!

My go-to order is the Anshim Katsu with the rice and miso soup, and I never skip the agedashi tofu. The katsu portions are generous, perfectly cooked with a crisp coating, and incredibly tender. My friend and I visit fairly often, and one of the things that keeps us coming back is the people. Nicki is a wonderful host who always makes us feel welcome, and her mother's cooking is simply outstanding. They've shared stories about how the business got started and the personal touches that go into each dish, and that genuine passion shines through in every meal.

If you're passing through the area, I highly recommend stopping in. Parking is easy, with plenty of nearby options, including a public garage right across the street. This is the kind of family-run restaurant that's well worth supporting.

Excellent pork katsu hot and crispy, clean taste. The cabbage sauce was tasty and refreshing. The pasta salad and fried squid were also very yummy. Love the fact that they have Asahi beer on draft. Staff is friendly and Nikki told us how her mom has put lots of effort to make sure the food is delicious. Will come back again to try other dishes. The portion is very generous so it’s best to bring people to share them dining in.

Delicious food and a clean, welcoming place. The fish katsu was super soft and really tasty. The chicken was good, though it could have been a little softer. The drinks were good, and the owner and staff were very friendly. Overall, I’d definitely come back.

I already had had dinner and I was walking the neighborhood while I came across this cute and authentic sushi place

The food was actually shockingly poor, the service disorganized and sloppy, but the prices are premium. To be specific, the tonkatsu was so thin that some pieces were just breading on less than a whisper of pork, yet it still managed to be very tough, the mixed tempura, rather than light and crispy, was a soggy, oily mess almost without flavor, the edamame were undercooked and undersalted, the california roll was a scant 6 piece portion instead of the typical 8, and the greatest offense was the plain rice. It carried a distinct, strong, and revolting aroma of perfume, perhaps from hand soap not sufficiently washed off when washing the rice, or someone walking by the prepared rice while spraying perfume. Regardless, it was inedible. The server seemed disorganized and unable to easily track the contents of a fairly simple order, in spite of the restaurant being quite empty, which is not surprising as the last time I ordered from them, about a year ago, they managed to forget an item entirely, in spite of my having paid for it.

In short, it's a terrible spot. I am mystified by the positive reviews, as the shortfalls were so many, and so serious, that this is unlikely to be a one off mishap.

Zombie sushi is good!

Food prepared with clean ingredients and authentic recipes. Highly recommend!

He told us all of the masalas (spice blends) were roasted and blended in house, something that truly makes a difference. The food was amazing, extremely flavorful and fresh; you can tell it's made upon order because everything comes out piping hot! It’s clear that they use fresh, quality ingredients and take a lot of care in their preparation.

What really sets Pochys apart, though, is the owner. He’s incredibly kind and generous, making sure every guest feels welcomed and well taken care of. It’s rare to find such genuine hospitality these days, and it really adds to the overall experience.

I truly wish Pochys continued success because it deserves to thrive. I’ll definitely be back soon to try more of their amazing dishes! Highly recommend.

I had a very disappointing experience with the food from this restaurant. The meal I received tasted spoiled and not fresh, which made it impossible to finish. Food quality and freshness are extremely important, and this experience raised serious concerns about how the food is being stored and prepared.

I hope the restaurant improves its quality control, because customers should be able to trust that the food they receive is safe and fresh.

Ok it’s been a few months since my visit because I didn’t want to write it right away but I had a disappointing experience.

First, they were out of a few items I wanted. This was Saturday lunchtime. Specifically, all the mini pan-fried buns. He told us after seating and ordering. Bummer but ok. Then we ordered. I won’t go into the details.

He tells us up front they are short staffed in the kitchen and we MUST take our entire order at one time. Okaaay. Well that’s pretty normal I think. So we ordered 5 items. Keep in mind there are three of us so that’s a sizable order I think. And it’s not cheap here.

After 15 minutes one item comes. Ok no sweat, I’m sure it’ll all be out shortly. Nope. 15 minutes later we all what’s up and he says they are short staffed in the kitchen. He’ll check. He brings out second dish. Two dishes in 30 minutes. Still three to go.

Now I’m noticing other tables have been getting their food. And they ordered after us. I’m like, what? I ask the guy again to check. Takes him 8 more minutes to come back. In the meantime I see even more people get their food. Finally he’s back: “I’m sorry, there was an error in the order printing machine”. I’ll make your food now.

It’s 45 minutes since ordering and almost an hour since sitting. I’m like, no thanks we can’t wait longer, we’ll just pay for what we had. He rolls his eyes and said he has to try and back it out, or something like that, like I’m really inconveniencing him. Another 5 minutes for that.

Don’t like the way it happened. Don’t like the customer service or the attitude. My few months cooling off period didn’t help I guess.

I will say the food we did get was good.

Everything about the sub was perfect, from the cheese (which actually pulls apart - I think the brand they used is Violife), to the ample amount of sauce that melts into the breading of the chik-n, to the soft texture of the chik'n itself. top_reviews.content:
Belly is a quiet little spot on College Ave right off the Rockridge BART station. We came around noon on a weekday and were pretty much the only patrons there for the duration of our meal outside of a handful of takeout orders.

Service was a little rough since there was only one person working, so we had to flag them down whenever we needed anything. That said, I completely sympathize with how tough it is to run a restaurant in the current environment, and I appreciated the effort.

We started with the kimchi arancini balls, which were excellent. They were fried nicely, the filling was ooey gooey and cheesy, and the kimchi aioli added a great cooling balance to the dish. For my main, I went with the 2 taco platter, which comes with a small salad and chips, and it was more than enough food. I tried one steak, egg, and cheese taco and one surf taco, and both had great flavor. The steak was cooked perfectly, the fried egg added a really nice richness and creaminess, and I loved the fries inside, which reminded me a lot of the Cali style you usually associate with San Diego.

The only real miss for me was the panko batter on the fish taco, since I prefer a lighter, more delicate tempura style batter. The flavor was still solid, just not something I’d order again. My bigger hesitation overall is the price, since the tacos are pretty steep at nearly $8 each and over $20 for the 2 taco platter, which makes it hard to imagine coming back frequently even though I did enjoy the overall flavors.

We just finished eating here for Restaurant week / Date night. Let me start off by saying the food is so packed with Flavor. We had the Kimchi appetizer balls it has Cheese Risotto and Kimchi. We had the Asian salad. It was light and crunchy and perfectly balanced. The Miso Butter Spaghetti was rich and full of flavor I added grilled chicken to it and that was a perfect combo. My wife had the Silk road spaghetti and added Salmon. It was tangy and spicy but not too spicy.  We will definitely be back here soon.       🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥

The food is incredibly authentic and unique, blending Thai dishes with Chinese techniques. Each dish has a balance of bold, complex flavors that reminds me of Thailand. I highly recommend planning your next visit to this place in your next Berkeley trip.

If you’re looking for a great Thai restaurant in Berkeley, I highly recommend Praaw Thai.

The restaurant has a very unique old Hong Kong style. The decorations are beautiful, and the atmosphere is cozy and fun.

We loved every dish we ordered, especially the Tum Strawberry, Emily’s Dumplings, Homemade Gui Chai, Tau Huu, Nookie’s Ka-ree Koong, Kao Pad Mun Puu, and Dok Jok. Everything was full of flavor and very tasty.

I forgot to take a picture of Emily’s Dumplings because we ate them right away—they were so good!

The Thai iced coffee was also excellent. It was rich, smooth, and not too sweet, just the way I like it.

Great food, great atmosphere, and friendly service. I will definitely come back and highly recommend this place!

Absolutely loved Praaw Thai in Berkeley! The food was amazing, the atmosphere was cozy, and the owner and staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming.

It's a splurge for me, but occasionally it's worth it. Friendly and efficient service. Nice outdoor seating area, good drinks selection.

We decided to check out Heroic Italian in downtown Berkeley, next to the library! The outdoor patio was so relaxing on a hot summer day.

If you love Italian food as much as I do, y'all need to check out Heroic Italian! Everything was so fresh and light. It's simply delicioso!

OMG! OMG! The OMG sandwich was light, airy, crispy, and delicious; while the Chicken Tetrazzini Rotini pasta was light, creamy, and tasty, it was perfect with the glass of white wine.

I love me a good salad, and the California Caprese salad did NOT disappoint. Not only was it beautiful, it was so refreshingly delicious! I want one now.

Lastly, the Calabrian Shrimp Roman Pizza was delicious. It was my first time having a shrimp pizza- it had the perfect balance of savory and tartness.

Ps. There’s a parking lot next door, and it cost the same as the street parking meter.

Heroic Italian is located next to the Downtown Berkeley Library on Kittredge Street not far from BART.  There is free 2 hour parking on the street, and there is a parking garage close by.

It is located on the bottom corner of a five story with lots of windows so the restaurant is filled with natural light. There is a large patio outside, so you have the choice of eating inside or out.

David, the owner is friendly and loves to share about his business!!! I had an OMG sandwich to go with an Italian Bio drink. I see why it is called OMG--it was very tasty made with fresh bread, Italian meats, smoked Mozzarella, and Roasted Artichoke Spread. Yum, yum!!!

They have a large variety of Italian wines to choose from to go along with sandwiches, salads, pizzas, and pastas. This is a great place to come for a taste of Italy.

top_reviews.content:
After visiting this place twice, it goes straight to top 2 on my favorite restaurants!

Every single dish was just an extraordinary explosion of taste in your mouth 🤤🤤🤤!

The service, just wow! The waitress was literally on top of everything. Even whit the room well packed of people. 👏

Something else I love of this place is the presentation of the dishes, it’s so clean, delicate and simple but effective! ❤️❤️

my fave thai place in the bay! i go with my grandma and we always order the sakoo. good veggie options, some less common dishes as well as thai standards, and their thai ice tea is dairy free and so delicious! the staff are always super friendly and accommodating and the interior decor is really cute. definitely recommend

Thai restaurant with good variety of Thai dishes and drinks. Food is a bit Americanized / fusion with OK portions.
Atmosphere is good for groups, kids, seniors and meetups.
Nice clean inside with beautiful decorations.
Indoor seating only.
Wide tables for kids and flat entry for accessibility.
Paid street and parking lot available.

There are many Thai restaurants in my neighborhood but Nua stands out.  The meals are so fresh and flavorful and the service is noticeably great.  The space feels roomy, bright, and airy. Lunch or dinner, my choice for Thai food here.

Really great Thai food with an upscale but casual vibe. We had the Sakoo (tapioca dumplings) and crispy rice ball salad to start, and our party agreed these were the highlight of the meal. But that’s not to say the standard of the mains wasn’t also excellent. For those we had crispy wonton pad Thai, basil eggplant and the sticky rice combo plate. All three were delicious, however I would probably get the standard pad Thai next time (this was my misunderstanding of the dish). This was a great spot for Sunday lunch with friends!

reviews_snippets.content: "Great vibe and decor, service is great and food tastes like homemade food."
"So grateful this place opened so close to home."
"We ordered the green curry with pork and the Tom Nuer Sapp soup."

top_reviews.content:
BIG bang for your buck. Sushi was so fresh like straight from the sea. Owners were this cute old Japanese couple who didn't really speak English. While we were eating they came over and gave us free sesame balls too! So sweet.

I got the special sushi combo of the day, and it was DELICIOUS. We were so full by the end in the best way possible. Will definitely be back.

Sun Sun Sushi is goated. Extremely fair prices for freshly made sushi. The owner is also very kind in a quiet way - one time, he replaced the container I grabbed from the shelf with a fresh batch he just prepared. There's also student discounts like BOGOF if you order on UberEats.
Lovely takeout place with great quality food, generous portions, and reasonable prices. The owner is also very kind and helpful. Even though the sushi is premade, it’s fresh and tasty.

Sun Sun Sushi is an amazing spot in Berkeley! The sushi is fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The staff is super friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend the signature rolls and the chirashi bowl. Great quality and great prices—definitely my new go-to sushi place!

The food was so good and fresh at such a reasonable price!! I first came here craving sushi just a bite of salmon but went home with 3 boxes worth of sushi 😂😂. Kind service and very close to home :) already took a second visit and will definitely come back again!

reviews_snippets.content: "Fantastic fresh sushi and fried snacks with drinks and chips too boot!"

name: Ox 9 Lanzhou Handpulled Noodles
address: 2404 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley, CA 94704, United States

google.name: Ox 9 Lanzhou Handpulled Noodles
google.address: 2404 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley, CA 94704, United States

top_reviews.content:
So excited that Ox9 Lanzhou Handpulled Noodle just opened in Berkeley! I used to have to go outside of Berkeley whenever I was craving good hand pulled noodles, so I’m really happy we finally have a spot like this here.

I ordered the  Beef noodle with pickles  (their recommended dish), and it did not disappoint. The broth was rich and flavorful, with a deep, rich flavor. The hand pulled noodles were fresh and perfectly chewy, and the beef was tender and well-seasoned. The portion size was generous and very satisfying.

The restaurant itself feels clean and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and helpful. For a newly opened place, they’re already doing an amazing job. Definitely a great addition to Berkeley, and I’ll be coming back!

I got the knife-cut noodle with beef and picked vegetables and it was wonderful!! Have not had noodles this good for a while in the bay. The noodles were chewy and the soup was aromatic and delicious. The staff members were also super nice and kind.

Don’t really know how to rate this cuz I have never had hand pulled noodles before. I was directed to order via scanning a bar code so it wasn’t easy to ask questions about what to order. The bone in chicken “big plate” was no joke about how huge it was lol. Maybe it was a special? It was kinda greasy though and didn’t have as much flavor as I was hoping. The noodles were good and chewy and large and flat. The marinated cucumbers were awesome tangy flavor and a fun shape. The sesame balls were awesome, as always of course. It came out super fast and if bulk amounts of heavy food were more your thing I think it would be great. Also they do not take Amex

we came a little before 6pm on a friday night and we only had to wait like 10min for a table. soon after the line for a table got longgggggg. i recommend the noodle soups with the belt noodle. id say skip the dry noodles since they were so greasy. we didn’t eat it.

It's a delicious freshly made wheat noodle place.  Their soups are famous
I ordered
Dry noodle spicy oil with braised beef 4.5 stars. It had some baby bok choy and bean sprouts and bit of carrot "angel hair"

Beef noodle soup 4.5

The calamari is terrible.  The neat tasted old and "fishy". I do not recommend 1.5 stars

Location nice. Small store with about 15 tables.  Had to wait 30minutes

reviews_snippets.content: "I waited almost nothing when I ordered my food and the service was outstanding."
"So Yummy really fresh love this place nice location"

Absolutely one of the best barbacoa tortas I've ever had. Reminded me of my abuelas tortas.

Mango Agua was also fire!

Cute seating, great environment, superb service, delicious food at a reasonable price.

See for yourself.

Carne Asada Nacho Fries were less than half the amount of food in the pictures, no flavor, fries were not fried or crispy almost warmed. Meat had no flavor and taste chewy and tough.

Pollo Asada was flavorless mostly lettuce, rice and beans were bland too.

Doordash needs to do give my money back, won't be coming here again.

Honestly I felt so good leaving here, like genuinely happy and full in the best way the food was incredible and came out super fast. The tacos al pastor were perfectly cooked with just the right amount of char and that salsa verde they have is addicting I couldnt stop dipping everything in it. The place itself is small but the energy is great and everyone working there was really friendly, felt like freinds even though it was my first time. Already planning when I can go back becuase I need more of those tacos.
Delicious quesadillas and super nachos... Plenty of seating on the back patio in Berkeleys Epicurious Garden. Great service too.

Beautiful restaurant in a beautiful location please come here now! Everything is made from scratch - including their Chicken Mole! It is a multi-stage-multi-hour process to make Mole & they are doing it from scratch 10/10 Highly recommend!!!! They are also family-owned and a really nice family — come by for some food or some pictures!!!!

reviews_snippets.content: "Delicious Tacos, chilled drinks and great service :)"

name: ThayirSadam
address: 2379 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley, CA 94704, United States

google.name: ThayirSadam
google.address: 2379 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley, CA 94704, United States

top_reviews.content:
Fantastic & authentic yogurt rice! (The TS comes in large portions, I couldn’t finish a single large TS.)

I consider myself a bit of an Indian yogurt connoisseur, and I believe this is the closest to home-style ThayirSadam that I’ve eaten in the US :)

The owner cares a lot about the food and experience, and took time to walk me through the menu and his story. (He told me how his son painted the mural with elements from his childhood and the restaurant’s theme — that was pretty cool!)

I will be back to try the other snack items.

I was intrigued by the traditional name of this South Indian place and decided to check it out during my first visit to Berkeley. Although the curd rice seems to be the star of the place (and much reviewed), I went for the idli vada combo with a filter coffee. Also, out of eye hunger, I ordered Maggi.

The portions were quite small for a full meal, so it’s better suited for a quick snack. The idli batter tasted a bit sour, possibly over-fermented, and the filter coffee didn’t quite live up to expectations. That said, the place itself has a cozy and casual vibe.

We ordered their signature dish, the ThayirSadam, along with curry puffs, masala bites, and filtered coffee.

Everything tasted fresh and was excellent

The coffee was foaming up top and rich.

Great place but really wish they served dosas

I would come here every week if they had dosas

Lovely, fresh, cheerful, simple, spotlessly clean, inexpensive South Indian spot on Telegraph. I tried the Idli Vada Combo with sambar and coconut chutney, and a cup of chai. The sambar was nice and everything was so fresh!  The vada was extra light and crunchy. I'll be back for the thayirsadam when I'm a bit hungrier! Check it out!

The star of the menu is their yogurt (curd) rice—simple, comforting, and incredibly satisfying. What makes it unique is the ability to customize your bowl with a wide variety of toppings, from spicy peanuts and chickpeas to paneer, fruits, nuts, and pickles, so every visit can be a little different.

The concept is refreshingly humble: take a beloved South Indian home-style dish and elevate it with fresh ingredients and thoughtful combinations.

reviews_snippets.content: "The food and place gives such a home cooked vibe 😄."
"They give you the options to choose the toppings you want in curd rice."
"The owner was wonderful and spent time explaining and serving us a lovely lunch."

name: La val's pizza
address: 751 San Pablo Ave, Albany, CA 94706, United States

google.name: La val's pizza

top_reviews.content:
If you’re looking for a true Berkeley classic, La Val’s Pizza absolutely delivers. This place has been serving the community since the 1950s, and you can really feel that history and character the moment you walk in. It’s a family owned pizza shop .The pizza itself is what keeps people coming back. The crust has a unique texture—slightly crisp on the outside with a hearty bite—and the toppings are generous without being overwhelming. Their specialty pizzas, especially the butter chicken and vegetarian piazza .

La Val’s isn’t about being the most modern pizza place—it’s about consistency, tradition, and comfort food done right. If you’re in Berkeley, it’s definitely worth experiencing at least once.

Highly recommended this place ✌️✌️✌️

New ownership, same amazing chicken tikka pizza!! Came by around lunch and was warmly greeted by the husband and wife who had just taken over the restaurant from a family member. They love the area, send their kids to school close by, and look forward to making the pizzas for all their neighbors :) Come by, have a chai, a curry pie, and support family run businesses!!!

Pizza is delicious!! and the customer service is amazing, such sweet people. They’re happy to accommodate any customization which is awesome. we’ve tried the desi vegetarian pizza and the paneer tikka both were amazing!! super vegetarian friendly and rlly good prices. highly recommend

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

One of the best pizzas I’ve had in Albany. We tried the Chicken Tikka pizza and the BBQ Chicken special and both were incredible. Everything tasted very fresh and you can really tell the ingredients are high quality. The crust, sauce, and toppings were all on point.

Roop and his wife provided amazing customer service and made us feel very welcome. If you're looking for great pizza in Albany, LaVal’s is definitely worth checking

We stumbled on this great family owned pizza shop after a comedy show when everything else was closing. They stay open until 10 PM! The owners are super friendly and mentioned they are doing lunch hours now too.
The pizza was incredibly fresh and delicious. They also make Indian inspired pies. We got a traditional pizza this time, but I will definitely be back for the chicken tikka next time. Highly recommend! 5 stars!

reviews_snippets.content: "Local family owned, great tasting pizza, super friendly people."
"Very soft crust perfect amount of cheese and all the ingredients are fresh."

name: Tacos Sinaloa
address: 2844 Sacramento St, Berkeley, CA 94702, United States

google.name: Tacos Sinaloa
google.address: 2844 Sacramento St, Berkeley, CA 94702, United States

top_reviews.content: This taco truck caught my eye on the street and I had to stop by. Im so glad I did because the fish burrito was so fresh and delicious 😋.  They serve the burritos with whole beans and other amenities. Great spot. Will be back
Would not let us order over the phone for pick up - had to order via Doordash, which charged us a service fee and was more expensive than in person. Burrito was also fairly dry.

Great experience came out at a lunchtime, rush, reasonable prices. They accept cash, Venmo, or Zelle. I was pleasantly surprised they hooked it up with a bunch of pickles. And salsas. Will be a regular.

Tacos Sinaloa's latest taco truck is located in Berkeley on the corner of of Sacramento Street near the Spiral Garden Nursery. (Great native plant selection) HEADS UP!  This taco truck is CASH ONLY at the moment.

The carne asada tacos were delicious for me!  My husband didn't like the dryness of the double stack tortillas and the over abundance of onions and cilantro but I was loving it!  We got two large horchatas, which were so creamy and refreshing. This taco truck is unique from nearby trucks because it offers ceviche tostadas.  I love the shrimp ceviche mixed with cucumber, salt, and Tapatio, all on top of a crunchy corn tortilla.  The to-go order comes packaged to travel well- with the ceviche in a plastic container with lid and the crispy corn tortilla in foil separately so it doesn't get soggy.  It comes with salt packet and the hot sauce on the side. It was filling but I still needed to taste the tacos too. To die for!  There is a sappy tree above the truck that will stick your shoes on to the pavement. That part is a bit yucky and I wish it felt a little bit more cozy.  But who doesn't LOVE tacos? I could eat them all day long honestly.  The price was $38 for 10 carne asada tacos, 2 horchatas, and 1 shrimp ceviche tostada. TOTALLY WORTH EVERY CENT!  I love Tacos Sinaloa and would recommend it to my hungry friends located in Berkeley for sure.

Cash only but you can order online? Also, prices went WAY WAY up. Food good, but NOT worth those prices.
A super burrito is and extra large burrito, not a burrito with extra filling.

reviews_snippets.content: "Our fish and shrimp tacos were tasty and super spicy."

address: 2491 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley, CA 94704, United States

google.name: Nom Nom Bánh Mì

google.description: Snug counter-service Vietnamese spot with classic banh mi sandwiches plus meatless & vegan options.

top_reviews.content: Checked this place out on my lunch break today. I had no idea this place existed, and I love Banh Mi. Requested a BBQ Pork sandwich, which the team member let me know they do not offer, but they have a grilled pork option. The grilled pork is marinated and was very tasty, and similar to BBQ pork almost. The pickled veggies were extremely fresh and tasty. The bread was toasted and crisp, the sandwich is quite long and wide, but not overly stuffed. The end bites were just bread, but not a big problem. There is a lot of competition in this area for this cuisine, and this one is just ok. They have a great location but need some music or something to make it seem more lively. This is a good alternative to Binge if you are really hungry for Banh Mi! The staff was very friendly.

Got a bánh mì chả lụa (they call it a district 3 ? lol) and it was good! Normal and what you expect from a banh mi shop. What’s interesting about this place is their very lavish colorful names based off of areas of Saigon and other places in Vietnam for what would otherwise be pretty normal banh mis so it was a bit funny as a Vietnamese person but yeah. I also got the coffee which was quite good. Prices though… I mean it is Berkeley what can I say.

Stopped in here before a concert with my partner and was excited to have bahn mi. This was one of the best bahn mi’s I’ve ever had, delicious, fresh, and the bread was perfect. A plus was the lychee iced tea and lemonade made in house, and their new offer of fresh spring rolls. 10/10 will be coming again!

From traditional Banh Mi to a California (bacon & avocado!), this great little shop on Telegraph is full of delicious food, great people watching, and friendly staff. Today I tried the Vietnamese coffee and noticed the subtext on the menu, "Sweet and strong, just like the Vietnamese lady who brews it!" <3
The tofu pagoda and basil seed drink are my go to order. The owner is kind. I do wish there was a bathroom or water station for guests.

reviews_snippets.content: "The drinks were also great-vietnamese coffee and lychee iced tea."
"They have a variety of different sandwiches and the owners are very kind."

top_reviews.content:
Great first experience.

For the location & price, cant beat that. Close to UCB. Close to Telegraph Ave , amazing for everyone.

We ordered online & it was a breeze ordering & picking up.

We ordered 3 Cheeseburgers burgers, 1 jalapeño burger, and one regular hamburger, two side fries.  Really good deal. Next time, we'll try the shake!

Definitely, a great place for the price. Will be back!

Solid burgers for really affordable prices with a mildly unnerving interior. I got a cheeseburger and fries for $7.70, the most economical option near campus. The cheeseburger had two thin patties and grilled onions, which were a nice touch. The fries tasted great, but I got a lot of bits less than an inch long. Food was out in 3 minutes - amazing.

This place is great, I was really impressed.  No frills cheap burgs that taste great and the lady at counter was really nice.  Parking is bad but that's obvious given the area and the music was like blasting which was slightly annoying.  Small, open air style seating, it's not a large interior so you may or may not have spot to sit depending on time.  For the price it's great and super tasty.  Their house sauce is really good, very different to in n out, I wouldn't say it's better but it's good

You get what you pay for, still good though. The only thing that I don’t like about their food is the house sauce, it tastes a lot like mayo, you can’t really taste the other ingredients they added for it to look orange/pink.
This place deserves more appreciation, absolutely fantastic burgers, the sauce is amazing! I haven’t had the fries but the burgers are great especially for the price

reviews_snippets.content: "Great and fast burger, hard to beat the price, taste and service in Berkeley."
"We ordered online & it was a breeze ordering & picking up."
"It only comes with sauce and griddled onions, no tomatoes or lettuce."

name: The Walnut Tavern Bar & Grill
address: 1508 Walnut St, Berkeley, CA 94709, United States

google.name: The Walnut Tavern Bar & Grill
google.address: 1508 Walnut St, Berkeley, CA 94709, United States

top_reviews.content:
Stopped in to be out of the rainy weather for some cocktails 'n dessert and we were not disappointed!

The Grizzly Peak cocktail was sweet - (green apple 'sweet')- was delicious! Enzo's Elegance cocktail (a minty  cucumber melon craft special) goes down smooth and tastes great!

The chocolate lava cake with vanilla ice cream was wonderfully chocolatey warm yet cold ice cream in the same bite. Strawberry & blueberry was an excellent accompaniment.

Absolutely would return for the dinner/lunch menu without hesitation! When we arrived (after lunch but before dinner time) was a perfect stop in point. Not too busy; just enough of a slow pace to enjoy the atmosphere, drinks, and sweet treat. Seeing the doggies go into and out of the shop next door was a cute sight as well!

Thanks to everyone for making it a delightful stop in.  12/20/25!

Poor food quality, poor service.

Food: My party ordered 5 entrees (grilled vegetable panini, fish and chips, short rib burger,  quinoa salad, and fish tacos) and one appetizer (baby back BBQ pork ribs). The grilled vegetable panini was very salty such that it was difficult to eat. The fish and chips were likely double fried such that the batter was almost inedible because it was hard and burned. The temperature of the pork rib appetizer was luke warm, and the meat was tough, like a leftover heated up in a microwave. The fish tacos were fair but not particularly good. The short rib burger was done well, and the quinoa salad was fresh tasty.

Service: Our server was was very insistent on selling us more items even when it was clear we knew what we wanted. He kept pushing us, which was uncomfortable. One of our water glasses was dirty and we asked for a new one, and the server did not hide his annoyance. Then he brought a new glass with warm tap water, sending a clear message.

Atmosphere: the dining room was pleasant and clean. We wanted to watch the a World Cup game and it was available on a TV in the dining room.

The menu is not too extensive. I appreciated the outdoor seating, reasonably priced cider and the mellow music. To be honest, the service was slow, the burger was dry and there were raisins in the coleslaw. I would return to take advantage of the street parking and outdoor dining.  (I ordered a Nepalese appetizer, fish and chips [nuggets?] and a kids meal.)

Best patio in Berkeley!  The service is always friendly and nice.  The food is prepared fresh and always so good.  Best momos in town!   My husband and I will come for wine, apps and sun.  Their brunch is really good too.   Dog friendly too

Walnut Square is a cool little shopping and eating inlet in Berkeley’s gourmet ghetto. At the west edge of the square you’ll find Walnut Tavern.

Dined here for brunch and enjoyed it quite a bit. They have a nice menu combination of breakfast and lunch items. I chose both! The steak sandwich and a waffle. I know, gluttony.

The steak sando was on ciabatta bread and cooked perfectly. I asked for medium and that’s how it came. Steak fries usually not my thing but these were crispy and seasoned enough.

The waffle loses points because it was soft and had no crispness at all. And the syrup was the fake maple. They improve that and it’s a winner.

The last dish was the Mom’s eggs Benedict which comes with ham. Hash browns were thin and crispy… perfect.

And the atmosphere of this little tavern is great. Natural light. Woody. And a bar. Makes me want to come here to watch a Cal game.

Service was a little spotty. Nice enough but kind of slow and didn’t quite get my order right.

reviews_snippets.content: "Great food, great service, portions were a bit small though"
"I appreciated the outdoor seating, reasonably priced cider and the mellow music."

top_reviews.content: Great Chinese food with authentic taste. They have a hotel next door which is connected to the restaurant and they are open till midnight. If you want great Chinese kebab, noodles, rice dishes, seafood, and dumplings. This is the place to be! Food is cooked fast and they accept card and cash. Will be coming back for the authentic and delicious Chinese spot next to Berkeley!

Some unique specialties you can’t get anywhere else. The owners are from Wuhan so the Wuhannese hot dry noodles are legit and the bbq skewers are perfect with generous dusting of cumin and spicy powder.

In a nutshell; great chinese food in the day, even greater at midnight.

Stopped by here to get some good food and something to warm the eve. As the nights were cool and breezy after a days activities. Parking can be a pain as you can only get lucky with street parking and can be tough when there's an event nearby or the aftermath of one. Nonetheless, place served great food even when you're the only customers during the late nights. Overall would stop by again if ever in Berkeley.

The lamb skewers were very on point. I also really liked the chicken gizzards, the tofu and the mushrooms. The lotus root was better in ma la tang. Ma la tang definitely had the ma flavor to it though they seemed skeptical when I asked for extra ma la. The staff was very attentive. Overall very happy with the late night food 🥰

I saw the hands of the owner’s as she brought food to my table, and those are the hands of hardworking people’s. I really appreciate their delicious food, and friendly service, and the value that they hold in the family and their business.
Probably this is also the only restaurant that opens until midnight in the area. It was almost midnight after I finished my meal, and I saw the owner still working hard to prepare fresh ingredients for tomorrow’s business.

reviews_snippets.content: "Great restaurant, cheap food, great quality, great service."
